Ageless Wonder.name: Ageless Wonder
Ageless Wonder.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS grant AUTO-BLOCK, FINAL STAND and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Ageless Wonder.sa2: Inflict IMMOBILIZE for 10 seconds and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when either fighter blocks a projectile.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Ageless Wonder is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown. Note that Crit Rate is a bit redundant on her as she does gain precision.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage by using PRECISION.

Altar Ego.name: Altar Ego
Altar Ego.sa1: While near an opponent and not BLOCKING, inflict a random DEBUFF for 5/7/10 seconds every 2 seconds.
Altar Ego.sa2: When using a TAUNT, remove all opponent DEBUFFS. For each DEBUFF removed, deal damage equal to 15/20/25% of Double's ATTACK to the opponent. Opponents defeated while TAUNTING cannot be revived.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Altar Ego is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.

Angel Maker.name: Angel Maker
Angel Maker.sa1: When TAGGING from Umbrella, the incoming Fighter gains 3 stacks of ENRAGE, 3 stacks of MIASMA, and IMMUNITY for 15/18/20 seconds each at the cost of up to 35/30/25% of Umbrella's MAX HEALTH.
Angel Maker.sa2: When Umbrella TAGS IN, gain 3 stacks of EVASION, 3 stacks of REGEN, and IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds each and DRAIN 25/30/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER from the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support fighter, Angel Maker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special Investmet: One niche investment for Angel Maker can be Tag Cooldown, allowing you to tag her in and out quicker and gaining buffs on your other fighters more often, but this is not a necessity by any means.

Apex Complex.name: Apex Complex
Apex Complex.sa1: While the opponent's HEALTH is above 65/50/35%, DASH ATTACKS inflict CURSE and grant HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds each on HIT.
Apex Complex.sa2: Inflict WITHER for 5 seconds and deal damage equal to 5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH every 4/3/2 seconds while near the opponent and benefiting from HASTE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Apex Complex is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY. While fighters should completely ignore Meter Gain due to her access to HASTE.

Armed Forces.name: Armed Forces
Armed Forces.sa1: 10% chance when either Fighter is HIT to gain ARMOR and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Armed Forces.sa2: When Cerebella gains a BUFF, 50/75/100% chance to transfer 1 DEBUFF from herself to the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: If built defensively, Armed Forces is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built offensively, Armed Forces is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, Meter Gain would help her perform better on the field.

Assassin's Greed.name: Assassin's Greed
Assassin's Greed.sa1: When either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER, the opponent loses 15/20/25% of their remaining HEALTH and suffers HEAVY BLEED for 5 seconds.
Assassin's Greed.sa2: Gain 3/4/5% HEALTH per second while nearby an opponent suffering BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Assassin's Greed is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense. When built offensively, Assassin's Greed is best built with Attack, Piercing and Meter Gain

Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant when built defensively. Accuracy is useful offensively to negate the opponent's Resistance so she can inflict BLEED and HEAVY BLEED more reliably.

Baba Yaga.name: Baba Yaga
Baba Yaga.sa1: Gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds when HITTING an opponent in the air. While benefitting from DEADEYE, HYPE MODE is extended to last for 15 seconds and Beowulf gains a HYPE CHARGE when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Baba Yaga.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, after a THROW, the opponent is shot into the air. Inflict HEX for 5/7/10 seconds while in HYPE MODE and hitting the opponent in the air.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Baba Yaga is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is recommended on Baba Yaga to inflict HEX more reliably. Meter Gain may or may not be built depending on whether you add Beowulf's TAUNT to his moveset.

Bad Hair Day.name: Bad Hair Day
Bad Hair Day.sa1: 10% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3/5/7 seconds.
Bad Hair Day.sa2: 10/12/15% bonus to CRIT RATE if opponent has BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Hair Day is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase Bad Hair Day's overall damage. Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED.

Bad Ms Frosty.name: Bad Ms Frosty
Bad Ms Frosty.sa1: 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.
Bad Ms Frosty.sa2: Gain UNFLINCHING for 3/4/5 seconds when DASHING. DISABLE the opponent BLOCKBUSTERS while benefiting from UNFLINCHING.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Ms Frosty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Bad Ms Frosty. Accuracy will ensure that her ARMOR BREAK will not be resisted by enemies.

Bare Bones.name: Bare Bones
Bare Bones.sa1: Gain THORNS for 8/10/12 seconds when using a SPECIAL MOVE.
Bare Bones.sa2: When reaching 3 stacks of THORNS, remove all THORNS and gain MIASMA for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Bare Bones is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her access to MIASMA, Meter Gain can be ignored.

Bassline.name: Bassline
Bassline.sa1: On TAG IN, gain HEAVY REGEN for 5/7/10 seconds and 20/25/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER..
Bassline.sa2: Landing a DASH ATTACK grants ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds and removes 1 DEBUFF from Big Band.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Bassline is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.

Special investment: Players can optionally build Tag Cooldown on Bassline to take the most use out of his Signature Ability, but it is not recommended as his Signature Ability does not hold much value.

Beast King.name: Beast King
Beast King.sa1: Inflict WITHER and CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds each when dealing at least 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.
Beast King.sa2: Inflict 10/15/25% bonus damage for each DEBUFF stack applied to either fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Beast King is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: There are two main ways to build Beast King, one being with Crit Damage and equipping three to four HURTING HURDLES. This build allows him to do significant damage per HURTING HURDLE and spam the special move with enough Special Cooldown. The other way to build Beast King is to equip Blockbusters like LUPINE PUMMEL and AIR WULF and build Meter Gain. As a fighter that inflicts debuffs, Accuracy is a common stat to build among both these builds.

Beat Box.name: Beat Box
Beat Box.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 3/4/5 seconds after using a SPECIAL MOVE.
Beat Box.sa2: Gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when using a SPECIAL MOVE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Beat Box is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Special Cooldown is the most important stat to build on Beat Box. Players can also build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Players are advised to not build Meter Gain as it makes his Signature Ability redundant.

Bellarina.name: Bellarina
Bellarina.sa1: When landing a DASH ATTACK, DRAIN 15% BLOCKBUSTER METER and gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds, and gain permanent 5/10/15% ATTACK.
Bellarina.sa2: While benefitting from DEADEYE, gain EVASION for 5/7/10 seconds when DASHING and transfer 1 opponent BUFF when HITTING an AIRBORNE opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Bellarina is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No special investment is required for Bellarina

Big Baddy.name: Big Baddy
Big Baddy.sa1: While Big Band is alive, opponents deal 20/30/40% less damage with SPECIAL HITS and BLOCKBUSTER HITS.
Big Baddy.sa2: When Big Band successfully lands a DASH ATTACK, drain 5% HEALTH from the enemy. When Big Band is HIT during his DASH ATTACK, he gains 2 stacks of AUTO-BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: On offense, Big Baddy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, he is best built with Health, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense. When using his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, keep in mind that Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special Investment: On defense, Crit Resist may be added to weaken Crit-based fighters against him.

Big Top.name: Big Top
Big Top.sa1: Once per match, RESURRECT with 10/25/50% HEALTH when defeated. Also gain INVINCIBLE and UNFLINCHING for 6/7/8 seconds.
Big Top.sa2: When either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN, remove 1 DEBUFF from self and gain HEAVY REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Big Top is best built with Attack, Piercing, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain
Special investment: HP will make her more beefy, allowing her to withstand more chip damage.

Bio-Exorcist.name: Bio-Exorcist
Bio-Exorcist.sa1: With at least 1 DRAGON CHARGE and not BLOCKING, DRAIN 1/1.5/2% of a nearby opponent's HEALTH per second.
Bio-Exorcist.sa2: While CHARGED, DRAIN 15/20/25% HEALTH from each living teammate when suffering a HIT that would be fatal.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Bio-Exorcist is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Biohazard.name: Biohazard
Biohazard.sa1: While above 50% HEALTH, gain 6 BUCKSHOTS when reloading with no SHOTS remaining. BUCKSHOTS deal 25/35/50% bonus DAMAGE and remove 1 opponent BUFF on hit.
Biohazard.sa2: While below 50% HEALTH, regain 50/75/100% of Black Dahlia’s MAX HEALTH when reloading with no SHOTS remaining.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Biohazard is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special Investment: This variant does not need any special investment

Biting Cold.name: Biting Cold
Biting Cold.sa1: Gain 1 stack of BARRIER and THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds every 3 seconds while near a dead body.
Biting Cold.sa2: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of REGEN for 10 seconds and 50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent. Defeated opponents cannot be revived.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Painwheel, Biting Cold is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. If used on offense, Biting Cold is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output on offense.

Blitz & Glamour.name: Blitz & Glamour
Blitz & Glamour.sa1: While on the opponent's side of the stage, Cerebella has a 15% chance on HIT to inflict INVERSE POLARITY and ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Blitz & Glamour.sa2: After 10/7/5 seconds while on her own side of the stage, Cerebella REMOVES all DEBUFFS from herself and gains IMMUNITY and REGEN. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Blitz & Glamour is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Blitz & Glamour, but players can also build Meter Gain to help her keep pressure on the opponent.

Blood Drive.name: Blood Drive
Blood Drive.sa1: 15% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED on yourself and HEAVY BLEED on opponent for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Blood Drive.sa2: When using a SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER, remove all BLEEDS and gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds per BLEED removed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Blood Drive is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Bloodbath.name: Bloodbath
Bloodbath.sa1: If either fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER, both fighters are afflicted with BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.
Bloodbath.sa2: 25/50/100% chance to convert all BLEED effects on self into REGEN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Bloodbath is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Bloodbath to use her Signature Ability more often.

Bloody Valentine.name: Bloody Valentine
Bloody Valentine.sa1: Regain 5/7/10% HEALTH when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Bloody Valentine.sa2: Regain 5/10/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Bloody Valentine is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.
preferred_moveset: Kephri Sun / Sekhmets Bite / Exile from Aaru

Blue Bomber.name: Blue Bomber
Blue Bomber.sa1: All BEAM and ENERGY attacks have a 25% chance on HIT to grant HASTE and inflict ARMOR BREAK For 7/10/12 seconds each.
Blue Bomber.sa2: Recover 25% HEALTH and gain 3/4/5 stacks of BARRIER when using a TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Blue Bomber is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting ARMOR BREAK. While Meter Gain will allow her to use a Tier 3 Blockbuster more often

Blue Screen.name: Blue Screen
Blue Screen.sa1: Gain a stack of ARMOR every 10/7/5 seconds. ARMOR is removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Blue Screen.sa2: When defeated, instantly detonate and inflict 25/35/50% bonus damage for each stack of ARMOR applied to Robo-Fortune.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Robo-Fortune, Blue Screen is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: Special Cooldown will allow her to annoy the attacker by using Bursts and moves like PHASER BURN.

Blue Streak.name: Blue Streak
Blue Streak.sa1: Grant DEADEYE and HASTE while Filia has at least 100/98/95% HEALTH. These BUFFS are removed when Filia’s HEALTH drops below 100/98/95%.
Blue Streak.sa2: Gain IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND and UNFLINCHING for 5/6/7 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER while benefiting from DEADEYE. Also gain 3 stacks of PRECISION.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Blue Streak is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is the most important stat for Blue Streak.

Bombshell.name: Bombshell
Bombshell.sa1: Gain ENRAGE, BARRIER or REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds when spawning a TEAR.
Bombshell.sa2: When DETONATING at least 3 TEARS at once, TEARS are UNBLOCKABLE and Parasoul changes outfits. DETONATING 5 TEARS at once inflicts STUN for 1/1.5/2 seconds on HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Bombshell is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Brain Freeze.name: Brain Freeze
Brain Freeze.sa1: While near the opponent, inflict IMMOBILIZE and SLOW for 7/10/12 seconds every 3 seconds. Reduce the opponent's ATTACK by 3% for every second they are IMMOBILIZED until they TAG OUT.
Brain Freeze.sa2: Deal 4/5/6% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent when either fighter is KNOCKED DOWN while the opponent is IMMOBILIZED.

stat_investment: General Investment: If built defensively, Brain Freeze is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built offensively, Brain Freeze is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, Meter Gain would help her perform better on the field.

Brass Bandit.name: Brass Bandit
Brass Bandit.sa1: Remove 1 opponent BUFF, grant ENRAGE for 10 seconds and DRAIN 3% HEALTH every 15/12/10 COMBO HITS.
Brass Bandit.sa2: Reset the timer of all active BUFFS for every 30/25/20% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Brass Bandit is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Meter Gain is also recommended.

Buffer Zone.name: Buffer Zone
Buffer Zone.sa1: When Robo-Fortune TAGS IN, remove all opponent BUFFS, inflict HEX and DISABLE TAG INS for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Buffer Zone.sa2: All BEAM and ENERGY attacks have a 10% chance on hit to grant BARRIER and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each. Also, transfer all active BUFFS to the incoming Fighter when TAGGING from Robo-Fortune.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used offense, Buffer Zone is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, Buffer Zone is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often on offense, while Accuracy increases the chances of her gaining BARRIER and UNFLINCHING.

Buzzkill.name: Buzzkill
Buzzkill.sa1: For each 20/15/10% HEALTH the opponent loses, inflict INVERSE POLARITY and WITHER for 10 seconds.
Buzzkill.sa2: While Painwheel's HEALTH% is higher than the opponent's, gain 1 stack of EVASION every 10/7/5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Buzzkill is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting INVERSE POLARITY and WITHER. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Candy Crusher.name: Candy Crusher
Candy Crusher.sa1: Gain REGEN every 5/4/3 seconds while OVERSTUFFED. REGEN is removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Candy Crusher.sa2: Once per match, gain permanent HASTE when reaching 5/4/3 stacks of REGEN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Candy Crusher is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her access to HASTE, Candy Crusher does not need to build Meter Gain.

Chameleon Twist.name: Chameleon Twist
Chameleon Twist.sa1: Gain MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent.
Chameleon Twist.sa2: 5% chance when HIT while a BLOCKBUSTER is charged to gain EVASION and MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Chameleon Twist is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Chaos Theory.name: Chaos Theory
Chaos Theory.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, inflict BLEED on yourself and gain ENRAGE for 6/8/10 seconds each. Also when TRANSMUTING to the LIGHT element, gain BLESSING.
Chaos Theory.sa2: DASH ATTACKS remove all BLEEDS. DRAIN 3/4/5% HEALTH per BLEED removed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Chaos Theory is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Chill Guy.name: Chill Guy
Chill Guy.sa1: When the active Fighter blocks a HIT, apply 1 stack of SLOW for 10/13/15 seconds. When the opponent reaches 5 stacks of SLOW, remove all SLOW stacks and inflict STUN for 6 seconds.
Chill Guy.sa2: When any teammate HITS a stunned opponent, inflict ARMOR BREAK and gain DEADEYE for 5/8/10 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Chill Guy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will ensure that his DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the enemy. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Class Cutter.name: Class Cutter
Class Cutter.sa1: All HITS from a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE have a 10% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE and inflict DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Class Cutter.sa2: Inflict HEAVY BLEED and HEAL BLOCK for 10 seconds when dealing at least 10/7/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Class Cutter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage are the most important stat for Class Cutter. Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies, and there's a higher chance of her Special Moves and Blockbusters being unblockable.

Claw & Order.name: Claw & Order
Claw & Order.sa1: CRITICAL HITS have a 25/35/50% chance to reset the timers of all opponent DEBUFFS except STUN and DOOM.
Claw & Order.sa2: Set the opponent's SPECIAL MOVES on cooldown and DISABLE their BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds when dealing at least 10/7/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Claw & Order is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature ability activating, while also elevating her overall damage.
This variant's color palette is based off the original Xbox 360 with its caption being a direct quote from Super Troopers (2001).

Clue Chaser.name: Clue Chaser
Clue Chaser.sa1: While Filia is alive, increase the active fighter's CRIT RATE by 5/7/10% every 3 COMBO HITS (up to 50/75/100%).
Clue Chaser.sa2: Filia's critical HITS above 20/15/10 combo hits ignore the opponent Fighter's ARMOR and DEFENSE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Clue Chaser is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special Investment: As her second ability ignores all forms of defense and her first grants up to 100% Crit Rate, it is possible to build her with only Attack and Crit Damage as high as possible, with all extra stats in one of Accuracy or Meter gain. However, is it advised to simply build a set for Windswept and reuse that set for Clue Chaser.

Cold Stones.name: Cold Stones
Cold Stones.sa1: THROWS have a 10/15/20% chance to inflict STUN for 6 seconds.
Cold Stones.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against STUNNED opponents.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Cold Stone is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Accuracy investment will allow him to inflict STUN reliably. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Comet Custodian.name: Comet Custodian
Comet Custodian.sa1: Once summoned, Hilgard will remain on stage until Marie is KNOCKED DOWN or TAGS OUT. While Hilgard is on stage, Marie has a 20/35/50% chance to prevent an incoming DEBUFF and inflict HEAL BLOCK and CURSE for 10 seconds each.
Comet Custodian.sa2: Remove all opponent BUFFS and increase damage by 33/66/100% for the rest of the COMBO when the opponent BOUNCES off a wall.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Comet Custodian is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chance for any DEBUFF to be prevented. Due to her damage output being already very high, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase it even further.

Corrosive Agent.name: Corrosive Agent
Corrosive Agent.sa1: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain 1/2/3 stack(s) of BARRIER when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Corrosive Agent.sa2: With 5 stacks of BARRIER, all SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and inflict SLIME on HIT for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used in offense, Corrosive Agent is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored. If used defensively, Corrosive agent is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: If used offensively, Corrosive Agent will appreciate Meter Gain to easily gain more BARRIER and spam unblockable shots.

Cosmic Rebel.name: Cosmic Rebel
Cosmic Rebel.sa1: Every 5th non-projectile COMBO HIT inflicts DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Cosmic Rebel.sa2: CRITICAL HITS grant IMMUNITY for 3/4/5 seconds, INVINCIBLE for 1 second, and 25% increased CRIT DAMAGE while the opponent is suffering from DEATH MARK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Cosmic Rebel is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage. Accuracy can be built to make sure the DEBUFFS from her first ability stick, but a death mark support can be used instead too.

Creature of Habit.name: Creature of Habit
Creature of Habit.sa1: Gain 1 stack of MIASMA every 5/4/3 seconds.
Creature of Habit.sa2: When reaching 5 stacks of MIASMA, convert them to 5 stacks of ENRAGE and regain 25/35/50% MAX HEALTH. ENRAGE is removed when Double is KNOCKED DOWN or TAGS-OUT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Jawbreaker is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.

Special investment: Special Cooldown is also another stat which players can choose to invest in. Players are recommended not to invest in Meter Gain as it slows the speed of her stacking MIASMA, and MIASMA itself gives her natural meter gain.

Criminal Mind.name: Criminal Mind
Criminal Mind.sa1: Inflict DEATH MARK and gain THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds each when either Fighter deals at least 10% MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.
Criminal Mind.sa2: Opponents are inflicted with BLEED for 3/4/5 seconds when dashing while suffering from DEATH MARK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Criminal Mind is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate investments will also allow Criminal Mind to take the most use out of DEATH MARK.

Crimson Cyclone.name: Crimson Cyclone
Crimson Cyclone.sa1: When either Fighter lands a THROW, gain ARMOR for 15 seconds. Cerebella's THROW HITS inflict HEAL BLOCK for 15 seconds and 50/75/100% of the damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.
Crimson Cyclone.sa2: Gain 15% BLOCKBUSTER METER and have a 50% chance to refresh the COOLDOWN of all SPECIAL MOVES when landing a THROW. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 30% increased damage per stack of ARMOR on Cerebella.

Curl Scout.name: Curl Scout
Curl Scout.sa1: For every 5th COMBO HIT landed on either Fighter, remove 1 DEBUFF and gain ARMOR for 7/8/10 seconds.
Curl Scout.sa2: While benefiting from ARMOR, gain 1% HEALTH, 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second, and inflict WITHER for 4/5/6 seconds every 4 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Filia, Curl Scout is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense. If built offensively, Curl Scout is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: On offense, she can be built with Accuracy to ensure that her debuffs aren't resisted by enemies.

Dame Slayer.name: Dame Slayer
Dame Slayer.sa1: Once per match when RELOADING with no SHOTS remaining, gain 6 LIGHTNING SHOTS and inflict DOOM for 30/25/20 seconds. DOOM is removed if Black Dahlia TAGS OUT or is defeated.
Dame Slayer.sa2: LIGHTNING SHOTS deal 100% bonus damage and cause the opponent to lose 5/10/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER on HIT (also applies on blocked hits).

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Dame Slayer is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her DOOM is not resisted by enemies. Players can choose to invest in HP to increase her survivability in the field.

Danger-Prone.name: Danger-Prone
Danger-Prone.sa1: Back-dashing grants HASTE and inflicts ARMOR BREAK on the opponent for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Danger-Prone.sa2: While benefiting from HASTE, both Fighters gain 50/75/100% increased CRIT DAMAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Danger-Prone is best built with Attack, Piercing,Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to her Signature Ability you only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special Investment: Meter Gain should be avoided due to her access to HASTE.

Dark Horse.name: Dark Horse
Dark Horse.sa1: Inflict CURSE and gain permanent HASTE after facing the same opponent for 15/12/10 seconds.
Dark Horse.sa2: While Marie is alive and benefiting from HASTE, all Dark teammates deal 25/35/50% BONUS DAMAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Dark Horse is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her CURSE isn't resisted by the opponent, while investing into some Crit Rate and Crit Damage will improve her overall damage. Players should also completely ignore Meter Gain due to her access to HASTE.

Dark Lord.name: Dark Lord
Dark Lord.sa1: Eliza starts the match with permanent FATIGUE. The first time an opponent is defeated while Eliza is alive, FATIGUE is removed, she gains 50/75/100% HEALTH, and she permanently gains increased CRIT RATE and CRIT DAMAGE by 50%.
Dark Lord.sa2: CRITICAL HITS inflict DEATH MARK, QUIETUS, or BLEED and grant ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Dark Lord is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special Investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will allow her to deal significant damage consistently. But do note that you only need 50% Crit Rate and up to 150% Crit Damage due to her first Signature Ability on kill boost.
preferred_moveset: Sekhmets Fury / Khepri Sun / Dive of Horus

Dark Might.name: Dark Might
Dark Might.sa1: When a teammate is defeated while Beowulf is alive, remove all opponent BUFFS. Also inflict 1/2/3 stacks of permanent POWER SURGE and permanent CURSE.
Dark Might.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from CURSE, SPECIAL MOVE and BLOCKBUSTER HITS have a 50/75/100% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE and grant UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Beowulf, Dark Might is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If used offensively, Dark Might is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: When used in offense, Accuracy is a recommended stat to build on Dark Might, as it ensures that defenders do not resist his debuffs.

Dead Heat.name: Dead Heat
Dead Heat.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 5 seconds every 10 seconds while below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Dead Heat.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for SPECIAL MOVES to be UNBLOCKABLE while benefitting from ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Dead Heat is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Dead of Winter.name: Dead of Winter
Dead of Winter.sa1: While Squigly is alive, the active Fighter inflicts WITHER for 10 seconds and gains ARMOR every 15/12/10 seconds. These effects are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Dead of Winter.sa2: When the active Fighter is benefiting from this ARMOR and about to suffer a DEBUFF, remove ARMOR to prevent it and gain 20/30/40% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Squigly, Dead of Winter is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Deal Breaker.name: Deal Breaker
Deal Breaker.sa1: Grant IMMUNITY, HASTE, or ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER. Also inflict GUARD BREAK and 2 random DEBUFFS for 10 seconds each.
Deal Breaker.sa2: 50% chance to grant UNFLINCHING, REGEN, or ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when a BUFF or DEBUFF on the opponent expires.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Deal Breaker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage, while Accuracy increase the chances of her gaining BUFFS.

Death Defier.name: Death Defier
Death Defier.sa1: Annie gains UNFLINCHING and 10/15/20% STAR POWER when DASHING. When activating STAR POWER at full meter, instantly empty it to gain 1 stack of permanent ENRAGE and MIASMA each.
Death Defier.sa2: When suffering a HIT that would be fatal, consume all permanent BUFFS on Annie to STUN the opponent for 1.5/2/2.5 seconds and then regain 5/10/15% MAX HEALTH per BUFF consumed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Death Defier is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

Death Wish.name: Death Wish
Death Wish.sa1: Every 7th COMBO HIT landed on Umbrella or the opponent TRANSFERS up to 1/2/3 enemy BUFF(S) to herself and inflicts HEX for 10 seconds.
Death Wish.sa2: Once per match when defeated, RESURRECT with 15/20/25% HEALTH and REVIVE all defeated teammates with 25% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: On Offense, Death Wish is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her HEX is not resisted by enemies.

Decrypted.name: Decrypted
Decrypted.sa1: Inflict 15/20/25% bonus damage for each of the opponents living teammates.
Decrypted.sa2: Transfer 1 enemy BUFF to yourself and inflict WITHER for 5/7/10 seconds when entering SEKHMET MODE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Decrypted is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow In Decrypted to use her Signature Ability more often.

Demon Artist.name: Demon Artist
Demon Artist.sa1: While CHARGED, inflict BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds for each 15% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.
Demon Artist.sa2: Gain ENRAGE and REGEN for 8/10/12 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER while the opponent is suffering from BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Demon Artist is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Diva Intervention.name: Diva Intervention
Diva Intervention.sa1: While in Sekhmet Mode, 25/35/50% of the damage inflicted by NON-BLOCKBUSTER attacks is regained as HEALTH.
Diva Intervention.sa2: While in Sekhmet Mode, NON-BLOCKBUSTER attacks deal 50/75/100% bonus damage and drain 4/6/8% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Diva Intervention is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Although investing in Meter Gain will seem redundant, having about 25% Meter Gain will allow Diva Intervention to get into a Sehkmet loop with a simple ground combo.

Djinn Frizz.name: Djinn Frizz
Djinn Frizz.sa1: Every 15/12/10 seconds gain 3 random BUFF(S) for 5 seconds.
Djinn Frizz.sa2: 33% chance when using a BLOCKBUSTER to convert 1/2/3 BUFF(S) into permanent ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Djinn Frizz is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting buffs into ENRAGE, while Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Don Passione.name: Don Passione
Don Passione.sa1: When Eliza is about to suffer a DEBUFF, 50% chance to prevent it and inflict either BLEED, HEX or QUIETUS for 8/10/12 seconds.
Don Passione.sa2: Gain permanent MIASMA for each DEBUFF an opponent has while exiting Sekhmet Mode (max 1/2/3 per exit). MIASMA is removed when the opponent is no longer suffering a DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Don Passione is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Don Passione has access to MIASMA and thus Meter Gain.
preferred_moveset: Sekhmets Fury / Sekhmets Turn / Exile from Aaru

Double Exposure.name: Double Exposure
Double Exposure.sa1: Successful BEAM attacks of SPECIAL MOVES grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and STUN the opponent for 2 seconds if they are not suffering from BLEED.
Double Exposure.sa2: When STUN expires on the opponent, grant EVASION for 10/12/15 seconds to Robo-Fortune and inflict HEAVY BLEED for 5 seconds to the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Double Exposure is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is necessary on Double Exposure to more reliably inflict HEAVY BLEED and STUN.
preferred_moveset: Catastrophe Cannon Alpha / Variable Cutter / Phaser Burn

Doublicious.name: Doublicious
Doublicious.sa1: 10/15/25% chance on HIT to TRANSFER 1 BUFF from the opponent to yourself.
Doublicious.sa2: 10/15/25% chance when HIT to TRANSFER 1 DEBUFF from yourself to the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Doublicious is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.

Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability. Players can also invest in Accuracy to increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Dragon Brawler.name: Dragon Brawler
Dragon Brawler.sa1: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when activating HYPE, and gain 100% increased CRIT DAMAGE while in HYPE MODE.
Dragon Brawler.sa2: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE and 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent while in HYPE MODE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Dragon Brawler is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: To get the most use out of his Crit Damage bonus, players are recommended to build Crit Rate and Crit Damage on Dragon Brawler. But do keep in mind that Crit Damage hard caps at 200% so you only need to build 100% Crit Damage for Dragon Brawler to be effective. If used with a taunt, Meter Gain can also be avoided.

Dread Locks.name: Dread Locks
Dread Locks.sa1: When HIT, reflect 15/25/35% of the incoming damage.
Dread Locks.sa2: If the opponent lands a CRITICAL HIT, inflict HEAVY BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Filia, Dread Locks is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this fighter.

Dream Band.name: Dream Band
Dream Band.sa1: MIRROR 1 opponent BUFF and reset its timer every 20/15/10 combo hits.
Dream Band.sa2: When either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN, reset the timer of all active BUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/7/8 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Dream Band is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat.

Dream Catcher.name: Dream Catcher
Dream Catcher.sa1: SPECIAL MOVES and TAG INS have a 25% chance on HIT to STUN the opponent for 4/5/6 seconds (does not affect Dark Fighters).
Dream Catcher.sa2: Every 3/2/1 second(s) while facing a STUNNED opponent, Peacock gains 1 stack of PRECISION, and her teammates gain 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER, and 5% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Dream Catcher is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will increase her overall damage using her PRECISION.

Dream Demon.name: Dream Demon
Dream Demon.sa1: Inflict permanent DEATH MARK and gain ENRAGE for every 20/15/10% HEALTH lost by either Fighter.
Dream Demon.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for Fukua's DASH ATTACKS to be UNBLOCKABLE if the opponent is suffering from DEATH MARK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Dream Demon is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY.

Eager Deceiver.name: Eager Deceiver
Eager Deceiver.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant 1 stack each of EVASION, BARRIER and BLESSING.
Eager Deceiver.sa2: 50% chance when using a BLOCKBUSTER while RAVENOUS to convert 1/2/3 BUFF(S) into permanent ENRAGE. Gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from 5 stacks of this ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Eager Deceiver is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting her BUFFS, Crit damage will help her deal additional damage while benefiting from PRECISION.

Epic Sax.name: Epic Sax
Epic Sax.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% damage bonus per COMBO HIT.
Epic Sax.sa2: Gain a random BUFF for every 20/15/10 COMBO HITS for 8 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Epic Sax is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Meter Gain is also recommended so that Epic Sax can do more combos.

Evergreen Evil.name: Evergreen Evil
Evergreen Evil.sa1: 5/7/10% chance when HIT while not at an ELEMENTAL DISADVANTAGE to gain REGEN and THORNS for 5 seconds, and to remove all DEBUFFS.
Evergreen Evil.sa2: When Double or any teammate gains a BUFF, its duration is increased by 3/4/5 seconds and Double gains 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a Defensive Double, Evergreen Evil is best built with HP, Defense, Resistance and Crit Resist.
Special investment: Meter Gain is a stat to be avoided on Evergreen Evil, as she can gain Blockbuster Meter naturally.

Fan Favorite.name: Fan Favorite
Fan Favorite.sa1: While Beowulf is alive, all teammates gain FINAL STAND and UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds each every 20 seconds.
Fan Favorite.sa2: Inflict DEATH MARK and gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds each when activating HYPE MODE while Beowulf has living teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Fan Favorite is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown

Special Investment: As Fan Favorite is most often played with AROO READY? it is recommended to avoid investing in Meter Gain. Investment in Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow him take the most use out of DEATH MARK.

Fatal Fray.name: Fatal Fray
Fatal Fray.sa1: When either Fighter lands a BLOCKED HIT, suffer a random DEBUFF for 5/7/10 seconds and permanently decrease the opponent’s ATTACK and DEFENSE by 4% until Ms. Fortune TAGS OUT or is defeated.
Fatal Fray.sa2: When either Fighter successfully HITS with a SPECIAL MOVE, transfer all DEBUFFS to the opponent and gain EVASION for 5 seconds and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds. If a DEBUFF was transferred, heal for 2% MAX HEALTH for each DEBUFF on the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Ms. Fortune, Health, Defense, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain are the main stats she aims for.

Special investment: Resistance may be avoided on Fatal Fray so that she does not resist her own DEBUFFS, however, this will depend on how you intend to use her. Crit Resist may be added to weaken Crit-based fighters against her.

Feared Faux.name: Feared Faux
Feared Faux.sa1: While Fukua’s Shadow Clone is active, SPECIAL HITS inflict CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds.
Feared Faux.sa2: While Fukua’s Shadow Clone is active, SPECIAL MOVE HITS deal 60/80/100% bonus DAMAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Feared Faux is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy is necessary to apply CURSE more reliably due to defenders often building Resistance. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like FOREVER A CLONE or LOBS OF LOVE.

Feathered Edges.name: Feathered Edges
Feathered Edges.sa1: A well-timed BLOCK grants 1/2/3 stacks of BARRIER, and DISABLES opponent BLOCKBUSTERS and TAG INS for 10 seconds.
Feathered Edges.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER, PROJECTILE HITS grant DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Feathered Edges is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing HP will allow her to tank more damage through her BARRIER.

Feline Lucky.name: Feline Lucky
Feline Lucky.sa1: Gain 1/2/3 stack(s) of PRECISION every 7 seconds.
Feline Lucky.sa2: 2% chance when either Fighter lands a CRITICAL HIT to gain IMMUNE, INVINCIBLE, FINAL STAND, and UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Feline Lucky is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature ability activating and increase her overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Final Fang.name: Final Fang
Final Fang.sa1: When the opponent gains a BUFF, MIRROR 1 of their BUFFS and inflict CURSE for 5/6/7 seconds.
Final Fang.sa2: 10/15/20% chance on HIT to inflict a random DEBUFF for 15 seconds while the opponent is suffering from a DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Final Fang is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting DEBUFF.

Fire Branded.name: Fire Branded
Fire Branded.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds and remove 1 opponent BUFF when using a SPECIAL MOVE or BLOCKBUSTER.
Fire Branded.sa2: While in STAR POWER mode, CHARGE ATTACKS consume all stacks of ENRAGE, inflicting STUN, HEX and CURSE for 1/1.5/2 second(s) per stack consumed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Fire Branded is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: To make sure her debuffs stick versus built defenders with Resistance, investing in Accuracy is highly recommended. Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

Firefly.name: Firefly
Firefly.sa1: While BLOCKING, the active fighter gains 4/5/6% HEALTH per second. When at 100% HEALTH, gain BLESSING for 8/10/12 seconds every second instead.
Firefly.sa2: While Painwheel is alive and the active Fighter is benefiting from BLESSING, grant 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second and a 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to refresh SPECIAL COOLDOWNS.

stat_investment: General Investment: Firefly on defense is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. Firefly on offense is best built with ATK%, Piercing, Crit Rate, and Accuracy.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Flower Power.name: Flower Power
Flower Power.sa1: Every 2 seconds, unless either Fighter lands a HIT, suffer HEAVY BLEED for 2 seconds. When HITTING an attacking opponent remove up to 1/2/3 DEBUFF(S) from self.
Flower Power.sa2: While not suffering from any DEBUFF, Fukua gains IMMUNITY, INVINCIBILITY, and UNFLINCHING for 2/3/4 seconds each when HITTING an opponent in the air.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Flower Power is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to benefit of INVINCIBILITY and lack of damage in her Signature Ability, investing in Crit Rate and Crit Damage can prove beneficial.

Fly Trap.name: Fly Trap
Fly Trap.sa1: Permanently increase Painwheel’s ATTACK by 25% for every 25/20/15% HEALTH lost by any Fighter. While Painwheel is the active Fighter, benched teammates also heal for 15/20/25% HEALTH.
Fly Trap.sa2: Gain 1/2/3 stacks of permanent REGEN when defeating an opponent. Gain MIASMA for 3/6/9 seconds every 3 seconds while benefiting from REGEN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Fly Trap is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further, and will scale with her first Signature Ability more effectively.
preferred_moveset: Pinion Dash / Gae Bolga Stinger / Snapdragon

Foot Soldier.name: Foot Soldier
Foot Soldier.sa1: HEAD HITS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant DEADEYE and 1 random BUFF for 7 seconds each. Also remove 1 DEBUFF from self.
Foot Soldier.sa2: Deal 5/7/10% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to either Fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Foot Soldier is best built with Attack, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will further increase her damage. Players should ignore investing in Piercing due to her access to DEADEYE and ARMOR BREAK through Ms. Fortune kit.

Fortune Cookie.name: Fortune Cookie
Fortune Cookie.sa1: After facing the same opponent for 10 seconds, Ms. Fortune suffers CURSE for 20/15/10 seconds, but gains permanent PRECISION, bypassing all BUFF and DEBUFF prevention effects.
Fortune Cookie.sa2: When CURSE is applied to Ms. Fortune, gain 1 stack of EVASION and HASTE for 10/20/30 seconds each, bypassing all BUFF prevention effects.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Fortune Cookie is best built with Attack, Piercing, Metter Gain and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Taking in count that her first ability grants PRECISION permanently, Crit Rate is not needed for this variant. Priorize Critical Damage instead.

Frayed Ends.name: Frayed Ends
Frayed Ends.sa1: 20% chance when HIT to inflict BLEED for 3/5/7 seconds.
Frayed Ends.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against an opponent suffering BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Frayed Ends is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED through RINGLET SPIKE.

Freaky Friday.name: Freaky Friday
Freaky Friday.sa1: CRITICAL HITS inflict BLEED and DEATH MARK for 3/4/5 seconds each.
Freaky Friday.sa2: Gain HASTE for 10 seconds and 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when defeating an opponent with a single HIT that deals at least 10% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Freaky Friday is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her inflicting bleed. Crit Damage will increase her damage output. Accuracy will ensure that her BLEED isn't resisted by defenders.

Freedom Fighter.name: Freedom Fighter
Freedom Fighter.sa1: 10% chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK and gain AUTO-BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds when either fighter is HIT (includes Blocking).
Freedom Fighter.sa2: When BLOCKING a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE attack, DISABLE opponent BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds and inflict STUN for 4 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Beowulf, Freedom Fighter is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy would allow his first signature ability to be more consistent. While Special Cooldown would allow the AI to spam WULF SHOOTs.

Freeze Frame.name: Freeze Frame
Freeze Frame.sa1: PROJECTILE HITS inflict WITHER for 9 seconds. When the opponent reaches 5 stacks of WITHER, remove all WITHER stacks to inflict STUN for 2/3/4 seconds and set the opponent's SPECIAL MOVES and TAG-INS on cooldown.
Freeze Frame.sa2: When removing WITHER from the opponent, DRAIN 5/7/9% HEALTH and BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Freeze Frame is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special investment needed.

Fresh Heir.name: Fresh Heir
Fresh Heir.sa1: DASH ATTACKS have a 50/75/100% chance on HIT to DISABLE opponent BLOCKBUSTERS for 10 seconds.
Fresh Heir.sa2: Gain 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when defeating an opponent whose BLOCKBUSTERS are DISABLED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Fresh Heir is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Even though Fresh Heir has Meter Gain built in to her Signature Ability, it is still recommended to build that stat on her, as she only gains Blockbuster Meter upon a fighters' death.

Fur Monger.name: Fur Monger
Fur Monger.sa1: 50/75/100% chance to gain ENRAGE, THORNS or REGEN when FIRING a SHOT. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Fur Monger.sa2: All SHOTS deal 5/10/15% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to Black Dahlia.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Fur Monger is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Players can choose to invest in Meter Gain to spam her Tier 3 Blockbuster.

Furmidable.name: Furmidable
Furmidable.sa1: CHARGE ATTACK HITS grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and 5 stacks of PRECISION.
Furmidable.sa2: While benefitting from IMMUNITY, SPECIAL MOVE HITS are UNBLOCKABLE. While benefitting from PRECISION, they inflict INVERSE POLARITY for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Furmidable is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Furmidable overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Although Accuracy is not important for Furmidable, it will ensure that defenders do not resist her INVERSE POLARITY.

Furry Fury.name: Furry Fury
Furry Fury.sa1: 10/15/20% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED and gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds each while Ms. Fortune's health percentage is higher than her opponent's.
Furry Fury.sa2: Remove 1 BUFF from a nearby opponent every 3/2/1 seconds while at 3 or more stacks of ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Furry Fury is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED and gaining ENRAGE, while Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

G.I. Jazz.name: G.I. Jazz
G.I. Jazz.sa1: Once per match, gain 3/4/5 stacks of REGEN and 3 stacks of ARMOR for 10 seconds each when falling below 25% HEALTH.
G.I. Jazz.sa2: While HEALTH is greater than 75/65/50%, gain 1 stack(s) of permanent ARMOR.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, G.I. Jazz is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat.

Galactic Glamour.name: Galactic Glamour
Galactic Glamour.sa1: 25/35/50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to inflict GUARD BREAK for 10 seconds.
Galactic Glamour.sa2: 25/35/50% chance when suffering a CRITICAL HIT to gain AUTO-BLOCK for 10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Galactic Glamour is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting GUARD BREAK.

Gang Green.name: Gang Green
Gang Green.sa1: Squigly gains BLOCKBUSTER METER equal to 1/2/3% of her MOVE SPEED.
Gang Green.sa2: Gains 1 stack of MIASMA for 5 seconds every 3/2/1 second(s) while not BLOCKING near a dead body.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Gang Green is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her innate ability to gain Blockbuster Meter through her Signature Ability and MIASMA, Meter Gain should be completely avoided

Glacial Ghoul.name: Glacial Ghoul
Glacial Ghoul.sa1: Gain BARRIER when gaining a DRAGON CHARGE. Also using your last DRAGON CHARGE converts all stacks of BARRIER into 5/7/10% HEALTH each.
Glacial Ghoul.sa2: While CHARGED and benefiting from BARRIER, gain permanent ENRAGE after every 10/8/6 seconds and permanent IMMUNITY after every 12 seconds. Both BUFFS are removed when the opponent is defeated.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Glacial Ghoul is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her ability to gain BARRIER, HP can be built to take use of it more.

Golden Gunner.name: Golden Gunner
Golden Gunner.sa1: Gain 3/4/5 stack(s) of PRECISION when RELOADING with no SHOTS remaining.
Golden Gunner.sa2: With at least 3 stacks of PRECISION, all SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and deal 50/75/100% bonus damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Trigger Happy is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Players can invest in Meter Gain, which allows her to use her Tier 3 Blockbuster more often.

Grand Mother.name: Grand Mother
Grand Mother.sa1: Successful DASH ATTACKS have a 50/75/100% chance to inflict CURSE for 5 seconds. When a DEBUFF on the opponent expires, inflict 1 random DEBUFF for 5 seconds.
Grand Mother.sa2: Permanently increase Double’s ATTACK and reduce the opponent’s DEFENSE by 0.5/0.75/1% each when inflicting a DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Grand Mother is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.
preferred_moveset: Bogus Buzzard / Hornet Bomber / Luger Replica

Grave Danger.name: Grave Danger
Grave Danger.sa1: When using a BLOCKBUSTER while CHARGED, convert all DEBUFFS into 10% BLOCKBUSTER METER per DEBUFF and gain HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.
Grave Danger.sa2: While on the opponent's side of the stage, gain DEADEYE and inflict QUIETUS for 10/12/15 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Grave Digger is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special investment is needed for this variant.

Gravedigger.name: Gravedigger
Gravedigger.sa1: Gain IMMUNITY and UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds each when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Gravedigger.sa2: Gain PRECISION every 4/3/2 seconds while benefiting from IMMUNITY or UNFLINCHING.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Grave Digger is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will increase her damage further by taking the most use out of her PRECISION.

Graveyard Shift.name: Graveyard Shift
Graveyard Shift.sa1: Valentine and all teammates gain HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds when any fighter is defeated.
Graveyard Shift.sa2: 15% chance on HIT to inflict CURSE and HEAL BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds when benefiting from REGEN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Graveyard Shift is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting her DEBUFF.

Gray Matter.name: Gray Matter
Gray Matter.sa1: All teammates start the match with 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Gray Matter.sa2: Once per match while Cerebella is alive, all teammates gain 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER when dropping below 25% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a supportive Cerebella, Gray Matter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain
Special investment: No special investment is needed for Gray Matter.

Grim Fan.name: Grim Fan
Grim Fan.sa1: Once per match, gain UNFLINCHING and IMMUNITY for 15 seconds when dropping below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Grim Fan.sa2: When Painwheel's UNFLINCHING expires, RESURRECT teammates with 20/25/30% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Painwheel, Grim Fan is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. If used on offense, Grim Fan is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output on offense.

Grin Reaper.name: Grin Reaper
Grin Reaper.sa1: Regain 15% BLOCKBUSTER METER and inflict INVERSE POLARITY for 10/12/15 seconds when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Grin Reaper.sa2: Gain a MORTUARY CHARGE and 2 stacks of MIASMA for 8/10/12 seconds when defeating an opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Grin Reaper is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her INVERSE POLARITY is not resisted by the opponent.

Gust Buster.name: Gust Buster
Gust Buster.sa1: HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal 15/25/35% BONUS DAMAGE and TRANSFER up to 3 opponent BUFF(s) to self.
Gust Buster.sa2: While CHARGED, CHARGE ATTACK HITS convert all BUFFS and DEBUFFS on self into BARRIER, MIASMA or ENRAGE for 15/25/35 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Gust Buster is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Hack n' Splash.name: Hack n' Splash
Hack n' Splash.sa1: A well-timed BLOCK against standard attacks grants 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION and inflicts CRIPPLE and ARMOR BREAK for 10 seconds.
Hack n' Splash.sa2: Landing CRITICAL HITS with Ms. Fortune's HEAD deal an additional 1/2/3% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH if they are inflicted with CRIPPLE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Hack n' Splash is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature ability activating and increase her overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Accuracy will also ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by defenders.

Hair Apparent.name: Hair Apparent
Hair Apparent.sa1: Using a SPECIAL MOVE grants HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds.
Hair Apparent.sa2: Using a BLOCKBUSTER has a 50/75/100% chance to reset the COOLDOWN of all SPECIAL MOVES.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Hair Apparent is best built with Attack and Piercing.

Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are largely redundant on Hair Apparent due to her innate abilities. Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to increase her overall damage, though the former will make her less effective against Painwheels with their Marquee Ability unlocked, especially TAINTED BLOOD.

Hallow Fiend.name: Hallow Fiend
Hallow Fiend.sa1: While none of Valentine’s BLOCKBUSTERS are fully charged, NON-BLOCKBUSTER HITS drain 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Hallow Fiend.sa2: If none of the opponent’s BLOCKBUSTERS are fully charged, BLOCKBUSTER HITS inflict HEX for 4/5/6 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Hallow Fiend is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Accuracy will help Hallow Fiend inflict HEX more reliably.

Harlequin.name: Harlequin
Harlequin.sa1: SPECIAL MOVES deal 10/15/20% bonus damage for all teammates.
Harlequin.sa2: COOLDOWN for SPECIAL MOVES is reduced by 25/30/35% for all teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Harlequin is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate investments will also allow Harlequin to deal more damage throughout the match.

Head Hunter.name: Head Hunter
Head Hunter.sa1: Gain one stack of PRECISION every 1.5/1/0.5 seconds while BLOCKING and not being hit.
Head Hunter.sa2: With at least three stacks of PRECISION, all BEAM and ENERGY attacks are UNBLOCKABLE and inflict POWER SURGE for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Head Hunter is best built with Attack, Meter Gain, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will drastically improve her damage output by taking use of her PRECISION.

Headstrong.name: Headstrong
Headstrong.sa1: THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE for 4/5/7 seconds.
Headstrong.sa2: Also inflict ARMOR BREAK for 4/5/7 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Headstrong is best built with Attack, Piercing, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain
Special investment: Accuracy will allow Headstrong to consistently inflict ARMOR BREAK and CRIPPLE.

Heart of Darkness.name: Heart of Darkness
Heart of Darkness.sa1: Once per match when TRANSMUTING to the opponent's element, permanently copy their Signature Ability, remove all their BUFFS and inflict HEX for 20/25/30 seconds.
Heart of Darkness.sa2: When defeating an opponent suffering from a DEBUFF, gain 3 stacks of MIASMA and inflict 3 random DEBUFFS on the next opponent for 10/15/20 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Heart of Darkness is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.

Heartless.name: Heartless
Heartless.sa1: HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal 25/35/50% BONUS DAMAGE. These HITS are UNBLOCKABLE when the opponent is below 50% HEALTH or suffering from at least 3 DEBUFFS.
Heartless.sa2: While Marie is alive, the last surviving opponent TAGS IN with HEX, HEAVY BLEED and QUIETUS for 10/15/20 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Heartless is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the opponent.

Heavy Handed.name: Heavy Handed
Heavy Handed.sa1: Gain ENRAGE and PRECISION every 0.3/0.2/0.1 seconds while charging a CHARGE ATTACK. Gain UNFLINCHING for 10 seconds when reaching 5 stacks of ENRAGE. ENRAGES will be removed when Cerebella is HIT.
Heavy Handed.sa2: Regain 10% MAX HEALTH and remove 1/2/3 opponent BUFFS when dealing at least 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Heavy Handed is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage investment will also allow Heavy Handed to deal more damage throughout the match and more reliably hit the 10% MAX HEALTH threshold.

Heavy Metal.name: Heavy Metal
Heavy Metal.sa1: 10/12/15% chance to gain ARMOR for 5 seconds when either fighter is HIT with a close-range attack (includes Blocking).
Heavy Metal.sa2: While benefiting from ARMOR, BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Heavy Metal is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.

Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat. Accuracy will also help to activate his first Signature Ability more consistently.

Heavy Reign.name: Heavy Reign
Heavy Reign.sa1: 50% chance on CRITICAL HIT to gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Heavy Reign.sa2: 50% chance to gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER when suffering a CRITICAL HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Heavy Reign is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and Heavy Reign gaining Blockbuster Meter.

Hell's Belle.name: Hell's Belle
Hell's Belle.sa1: While the opponent's HEALTH is above 35%, 10/12/15% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 5 seconds and a random DEBUFF.
Hell's Belle.sa2: Every 10 seconds as the active Fighter, Fukua grants her teammates MIASMA for 10/12/15 seconds and EVASION.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Hell's Belle is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Hell's Belle, as it increases the chances of her inflicting debuff and stops her debuffs being resisted by defenders.

Hellcat.name: Hellcat
Hellcat.sa1: Gain ENRAGE after every 12/10/8 seconds while above 50% HEALTH. ENRAGE is removed when dropping below 50% HEALTH.
Hellcat.sa2: Gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION when defeating an opponent while benefiting from ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Hellcat is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Hellcat overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Hex Caliber.name: Hex Caliber
Hex Caliber.sa1: Every 10th COMBO HIT landed on Black Dahlia or the opponent grants UNFLINCHING for 5/7/10 seconds. Also gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from this UNFLINCHING.
Hex Caliber.sa2: ALL SHOTS are UNBLOCKABLE and grant IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds while benefiting from PRECISION.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Hex Caliber is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown and Crit Damage. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Players can also invest in Meter Gain. Players should completely ignore Crit Rate as she can have constant uptime of PRECISION.

High Ruler.name: High Ruler
High Ruler.sa1: Opponents have their BLOCKBUSTERS and TAG-INS DISABLED after 3/2/1 second(s) while near a TEAR.
High Ruler.sa2: Detonated TEARS inflict CURSE and HEX for 5/7/10 seconds on HIT. Dark Fighters also suffer FATIGUE for 5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, High Ruler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that she can inflict her DEBUFFS reliably.

Hype Man.name: Hype Man
Hype Man.sa1: While in HYPE MODE, DRAIN opponent BLOCKBUSTER METER by 5/7/10% per landed HIT.
Hype Man.sa2: When activating HYPE MODE, teammates in reserve gain 25/35/50% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Hype Man is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Due to his innate ability to gain Blockbuster Meter through his Signature Ability, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain.

Icy Hot.name: Icy Hot
Icy Hot.sa1: All teammates TAG IN with REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.
Icy Hot.sa2: On TAG IN, all teammates gain 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Icy Hot is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Idol Echo.name: Idol Echo
Idol Echo.sa1: Gain 1 random BUFF and inflict 1 random DEBUFF every 3/2/1 second(s) while in a combo. All BUFFS and DEBUFFS are removed at the end of a combo.
Idol Echo.sa2: Fukua deals 5/7/10% more damage per BUFF applied to her. When Fukua gains 10 or more BUFFS, remove all opponent BUFFS.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Idol Echo is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage are other useful stats to give Idol to boost her damage further. Accuracy may otherwise be used so that she can DEBUFF opponent's more consistently.

Idol Threat.name: Idol Threat
Idol Threat.sa1: EVADING an attack grants FINAL STAND and ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds.
Idol Threat.sa2: Inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5 seconds when HITTING an attacking opponent. Additionally, 100/150/200% of the damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Idol Threat is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her ARMOR BREAK will not be resisted by enemies.

Immoral Fiber.name: Immoral Fiber
Immoral Fiber.sa1: When defeated, deal damage equivalent to 25/35/50% of your MAX HEALTH.
Immoral Fiber.sa2: When defeated, heal all teammates by 25/35/50% of your MAX HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a Defensive Double, Immoral Fiber is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: HP is the most important stat for Immoral Fiber, as it allows her to deal significant damage on death.

In Denile.name: In Denile
In Denile.sa1: Inflict ARMOR BREAK for 5/10/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode.
In Denile.sa2: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/10/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, In Denile is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow In Denile to use her Signature Ability more often.

Indomitable.name: Indomitable
Indomitable.sa1: Grant DEADEYE and inflict HEAL BLOCK when the opponent's HEALTH drops below 60/70/80%. Both effects are removed if Parasoul is KNOCKED DOWN.
Indomitable.sa2: Transfer 1 opponent BUFF and gain MIASMA for 7 seconds every 5/4/3 seconds while on the opponent's side of the stage and benefiting from DEADEYE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Indomitable is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Infernal Twin.name: Infernal Twin
Infernal Twin.sa1: When hitting an attacking opponent, gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds and refresh the duration of all ENRAGES.
Infernal Twin.sa2: When HIT while benefiting from 5/4/3 stacks of ENRAGE, inflict FATIGUE for 5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Infernal Twin is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Inkfluencer.name: Inkfluencer
Inkfluencer.sa1: NON-BLOCKBUSTER PROJECTILES inflict SLIME and INK the opponent for 10 seconds each, and DRAIN 10/15/20% BLOCKBUSTER METER on HIT. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 20% more damage per stack of INK (up to 5 stacks).
Inkfluencer.sa2: Gain BARRIER when entering or exiting THE HOLE IDEA. While in THE HOLE IDEA, SPECIAL MOVES recharge 50/75/100% faster and gain 10/20/30% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Inkfluencer is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy can be used if you want to inflict SLIME more reliably. With her high Attack stat, Crit Rate and Crit Damage can also be used to increase her damage higher.

Inkling.name: Inkling
Inkling.sa1: Deal 15/20/25% bonus damage for each living teammate.
Inkling.sa2: SPECIAL MOVES have a 15/20/25% chance to be UNBLOCKABLE while Peacock has living teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Inkling is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Special Moves being unblockable.

Inner Pieces.name: Inner Pieces
Inner Pieces.sa1: When entering Sekhmet Mode, gain a BUFF for 10/12/15 seconds per teammate. The BUFF gained is determined by each teammate's ELEMENT.
Inner Pieces.sa2: 50/75/100% chance when TAGGING to or from Eliza for all active BUFFS to transfer to the incoming Fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Inner Pieces is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Inner Pieces to use her Signature Ability more often.

Ionic Icon.name: Ionic Icon
Ionic Icon.sa1: All teammates' TAG IN attacks inflict DEATH MARK for 10/15/20 seconds and STUN the opponent for 4 seconds. Peacock also gains 1/2/3 stack of BARRIER.
Ionic Icon.sa2: Every 15 COMBO HITS by a Light Element teammate removes 1 opponent BUFF and inflicts POWER SURGE for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Ionic Icon is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS are not resisted by the enemy. With Tag Cooldown, Rerun becomes redundant for most use-cases. Do note that with rerun and Tag Cooldown it is possible to keep enemies stunned indefinitely.

Iron Matron.name: Iron Matron
Iron Matron.sa1: Detonated TEARS grant 1 stack of ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds on HIT.
Iron Matron.sa2: DASH ATTACKS are UNBLOCKABLE while benefiting from at least 3 stacks of ENRAGE. Successful DASH ATTACKS grant MIASMA and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 3/4/5 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Iron Matron is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.
preferred_moveset: Inferno Brigade / Canopy Bounce / Silent Scope

Ivy League.name: Ivy League
Ivy League.sa1: Inflict SLOW for 5/7/10 seconds when spawning a TEAR. Opponents are IMMOBILIZED while near a TEAR.
Ivy League.sa2: DRAIN 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second while the opponent is near a TEAR.
