stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Ivy League is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need 100% Crit Damage from move stat increases.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by defenders. Crit Rate and Crit Damage can be ignored if using a critless build.

Jack-O-Specter.name: Jack-O-Specter
Jack-O-Specter.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 10/12/15 seconds when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Jack-O-Specter.sa2: Inflict 3 random DEBUFFS on the opponent for 10/12/15 seconds each when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Jack-O-Specter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special Investment: Accuracy a worthwhile stat for Jack-O-Specter to ensure her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies.

Jawbreaker.name: Jawbreaker
Jawbreaker.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, gain a random BUFF for 5/6/7 seconds.
Jawbreaker.sa2: Deal 10/15/20% bonus damage for each BUFF applied to Double.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Jawbreaker is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Meter Gain and Special Cooldown are also stats which players can choose to invest in.

Just Kitten.name: Just Kitten
Just Kitten.sa1: 25/35/50% chance when suffering a DEBUFF to immediately convert that DEBUFF to a stack of PRECISION.
Just Kitten.sa2: 5/10/15% chance when either Fighter is hit by any non-projectile HIT to gain 1 stack of EVASION and HASTE for 10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Just Kitten is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Just Kitten's overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Accuracy is replaces the need for Meter Gain, since it will help activate her 2nd Signature Ability more often to give her HASTE.

Kill Joy.name: Kill Joy
Kill Joy.sa1: Teammates gain permanent REGEN when first dropping below 25/35/50% HEALTH while at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE.
Kill Joy.sa2: Once per match on DEATH, RESURRECT all defeated teammates with 15/20/25% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Kill Joy is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Killing Time.name: Killing Time
Killing Time.sa1: CHARGE ATTACKS are extended with an extra hit and can be charged longer for extra damage. Landing a CHARGE ATTACK grants permanent DEADEYE and adds 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER for each hit landed until the end of her combo.
Killing Time.sa2: BLOCKBUSTER HITS inflict CURSE for 10 seconds. If a BLOCKBUSTER HIT occurs after a CHARGE ATTACK in the same combo, gain 3/4/5 stacks of permanent ENRAGE until the end of her combo.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Killing Time is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Lapis Luxury.name: Lapis Luxury
Lapis Luxury.sa1: Once per match when TAGGING IN, match the meter value of the opponent's highest BLOCKBUSTER METER and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Lapis Luxury.sa2: Once per match when using a TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER, switch HEALTH percentages with the opponent and gain HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Lapis Luxury is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Lapis Luxury to use her Signature Ability more often.

Last Hope.name: Last Hope
Last Hope.sa1: While Valentine is alive, when any teammate is defeated, RESURRECT that teammate with 15/20/25% HEALTH. This effect only occurs once per other teammate.
Last Hope.sa2: Also grant HEAVY REGEN for 5/10/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Valentine, Last Hope is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Lethal Weapon.name: Lethal Weapon
Lethal Weapon.sa1: All SHOTS have a 50/75/100% chance to inflict BLEED for 10 seconds.
Lethal Weapon.sa2: Gain 1/2/3% METER and 1% HEALTH per second while nearby an opponent suffering BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Lethal Weapon is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her BLEED is not resisted by enemies.

Locked 'N' Loaded.name: Locked 'N' Loaded
Locked 'N' Loaded.sa1: When FIRING a SHOT, sacrifice 3% of Black Dahlia's MAX HEALTH to inflict WITHER and gain 5/7/8% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Locked 'N' Loaded.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, DRAIN 3/4/5% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH per stack of WITHER and convert all stacks of WITHER on the opponent to INVERSE POLARITY for 3 seconds per stack.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Locked ‘N’ Loaded is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special Investmet Players are also recommended invest into Accuracy to more reliably inflict the WITHER and INVERSE POLARITY.

Locked In.name: Locked In
Locked In.sa1: While near a TEAR, 50/75/100% chance for SPECIAL MOVES to grant HASTE for 15 seconds and remove 1 opponent BUFF.
Locked In.sa2: While at least 1 TEAR is on the stage, CRITICAL HITS grant INVINCIBLE for 1 second and 5/7/10% of all CRIT DAMAGE dealt is regained as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Locked In is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.

Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and her gaining INVINCIBILITY, this makes her a reliable counter to TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability as well as Reflect Damage.

Love Crafted.name: Love Crafted
Love Crafted.sa1: While near an opponent, DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS and inflict HEAL BLOCK after 3/2/1 second(s).
Love Crafted.sa2: Every 10th COMBO HIT will land as a CRITICAL HIT, and will inflict DEATH MARK and HEAVY BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Love Crafted is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage by taking use of DEATH MARK.

Lucky Lure.name: Lucky Lure
Lucky Lure.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, the active Fighter has a 30/40/50% chance to gain a BUFF based on a random teammate’s ELEMENT for 7 seconds when landing a CRITICAL HIT.
Lucky Lure.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, increase the active Fighter’s CRIT DAMAGE by 5/10/15% per stack of REGEN on the Fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Lucky Lure is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy will increase the odds of Lucky Lure's first Signature Ability for activating for the whole team and Crit Rate will boost the odds of Lucky Lure's first Signature Ability activating for herself.

M-3OW.name: M-3OW
M-3OW.sa1: Deal 50/75/100% bonus damage while Robo-Fortune is far away from the opponent.
M-3OW.sa2: Gain INVINCIBLE for 3/4/5 seconds after 3 seconds while far away from the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, M-3OW is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage.

Mad Malice.name: Mad Malice
Mad Malice.sa1: While Marie is alive, her teammates' CRITICAL HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to grant ENRAGE for 10/13/15 seconds.
Mad Malice.sa2: Marie gains permanent ENRAGE for every 50/40/30% HEALTH lost by any teammate or opponent. Gain permanent PRECISION while benefiting from 5 stacks of this ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support Marie, Mad Malice is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her teammates have a higher chance of gaining ENRAGE. Due to her access to PRECISION Crit Rate should be avoided but Crit Damage will increase her damage output greatly.

Magicurl.name: Magicurl
Magicurl.sa1: When the active Fighter is about to suffer a DEBUFF, Filia sacrifices 10% MAX HP to give the active Fighter IMMUNITY for 3/4/5 seconds. This effect can only trigger once every 10 seconds.
Magicurl.sa2: Also deal 10% MAX HEALTH damage to the opponent and inflict HEAL BLOCK for 5 seconds. Filia’s BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL HITS have a 25/30/35% chance of healing her for 10% MAX HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Magicurl is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will allow her to activate her SA2 healing more reliable and ensure that her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies.

Maid of Honor.name: Maid of Honor
Maid of Honor.sa1: While Marie is alive, HITS blocked by all teammates have a 25/35/50% chance to convert 1 DEBUFF into a stack of BARRIER.
Maid of Honor.sa2: While Marie is alive, all teammates recover 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second while benefitting from BARRIER.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used offensively, Maid of Honor is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. If used defensively, Maid of Honor is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates converting debuffs.

Mana Flow.name: Mana Flow
Mana Flow.sa1: Squigly's standard BLOCKBUSTERS consume all DRAGON CHARGES to gain additional effects per DRAGON CHARGE. Gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when gaining a DRAGON CHARGE and automatically gain 25% DRAGON CHARGE per second.
Mana Flow.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain permanent PRECISION until the COMBO ends. Permanently gain 10/15/20% ATTACK when spending a DRAGON CHARGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Mana Flow is best built with Attack*, Piercing and Special Cooldown. While Attack is recommended, due to the permanent ATTACK boosts not scaling with it, it is not as important compared to other Squiglys.
While Attack is recommended, due to the permanent ATTACK boosts not scaling with it, it is not as important compared to other Squiglys.

Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage by taking use of PRECISION and the permanent ATTACK boosts. Crit Rate is not necessary to build however if you are able to start every combo with PRECISION

Martial Outlaw.name: Martial Outlaw
Martial Outlaw.sa1: Any teammate's CHARGE ATTACK HITS grant HASTE for 8/10/12 seconds.
Martial Outlaw.sa2: All teammates have a 15/20/25% chance on HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK and HEAVY BLEED for 10 seconds each while benefiting from HASTE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Martial Outlaw is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting HEAVY BLEED and ARMOR BREAK while Martial Outlaw is in the bench.

Masked Menace.name: Masked Menace
Masked Menace.sa1: While near an opponent, inflict CURSE and QUIETUS for 2 seconds after every 3/2/1 second(s).
Masked Menace.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from QUIETUS, landing a BURST inflicts permanent DOOM for 25/20/15 seconds and heals 15% HEALTH. DOOM is removed when the opponent gains a BUFF or Painwheel dies.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Masked Menace is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her CURSE and QUIETUS are not resisted. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further.

Materia Girl.name: Materia Girl
Materia Girl.sa1: 20% chance to gain 5/7/10% STAR POWER meter when either Fighter is HIT (includes Blocking).
Materia Girl.sa2: While in STAR POWER MODE, gain permanent PRECISION, DEADEYE or HASTE, and 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second. The permanent BUFF is removed when exiting STAR POWER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Materia Girl is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating. While investing in Crit Damage will increase her damage further by taking use of her PRECISION. Building Meter Gain allows Materia Girl to forgo the HASTE buff and focus solely on utilising DEADEYE or PRECISION.

Mean One.name: Mean One
Mean One.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds for every BUFF gained by the opponent.
Mean One.sa2: Projectiles have a 25/35/50% chance on HIT to convert 1 opponent BUFF into a random DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Mean One is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her converting the opponents BUFFS.

Megalomaniac.name: Megalomaniac
Megalomaniac.sa1: While Marie is alive, she gains permanent ARMOR and EVASION for 10 seconds for every 40/35/30% HEALTH lost by any teammate. 1 stack of ARMOR is removed when her opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Megalomaniac.sa2: While Marie is the active Fighter, is fighting the same opponent, and has at least 3 stacks of ARMOR, she inflicts STUN for 2/3/4 seconds every 10 seconds and DRAINS 10% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Marie, Megalomaniac is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: Crit Resist is an optional stat for Megalomaniac, as it will stop opponents from using DESTRUCTION PILLAR.

Megasonic.name: Megasonic
Megasonic.sa1: When blocking a HIT, reduce damage taken by 25/50/75% and gain ENRAGE and THORNS for 10 seconds. One ENRAGE stack is removed every 10th COMBO HITS.
Megasonic.sa2: While benefiting from ENRAGE, 25/35/50% of the damage dealt is regained as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Megasonic is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output.

Mekastar.name: Mekastar
Mekastar.sa1: If none of Cerebella's BLOCKBUSTERS are fully charged, gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds and 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 3 seconds while not BLOCKING.
Mekastar.sa2: Gain BARRIER and inflict CURSE for 15 seconds each when using a BLOCKBUSTER. Also while benefiting from ENRAGE, 3% chance on HIT to instantly defeat the opponent if they have less than 30/40/50% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Mekastar is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Players can choose to build Accuracy to increase the chances of her instant kill from activating and stop her CURSE from being resisted. Meter Gain is also a choice stat for players to invest in Mekastar, but the lack of Meter Gain will allow her to stack ENRAGE more often.

Meow & Furever.name: Meow & Furever
Meow & Furever.sa1: Gain FINAL STAND for 10 seconds and 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION for every 10% HEALTH LOST.
Meow & Furever.sa2: Enemy is inflicted with DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds and STUN for 4 seconds when FINAL STAND expires.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used offensively, Meow & Furever is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: If used offensively, Crit Damage will increase Meow & Furever's overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Miss Mercury.name: Miss Mercury
Miss Mercury.sa1: 9/11/13% chance on HIT to gain 13% STAR POWER and inflict QUIETUS for 13 seconds.
Miss Mercury.sa2: When activating STAR POWER, instantly empty it to convert 1/2/3 BUFFS on the opponent to random DEBUFFS for 13 seconds. Also inflict CURSE for 13 seconds when activated at full meter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an Offensive Annie, Miss Mercury will need Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate (for the Destruction Pillars) and Special Cooldown. Some Meter Gain may also be helpful for filling up Miss Mercury's Blockbusters to help extend long combos and gain more STAR METER.
Special investment: investing in Accuracy will help Miss Mercury increase her chances of converting opponent BUFFS into DEBUFFS and have a higher percent chance on gaining STAR METER.

Model Leader.name: Model Leader
Model Leader.sa1: While Annie is alive, she clears the active Fighter's DEBUFFS and grants ARMOR for 15 seconds every 30/25/20 seconds. Water teammates also gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 15 seconds.
Model Leader.sa2: Gain permanent AUTO-BLOCK for each 25/20/15% HEALTH lost. All Teammates benefiting from ARMOR or AUTO-BLOCK gain 4/5/6% BLOCKBUSTER METER when using a SPECIAL MOVE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Annie, Model Leader is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Moody Magus.name: Moody Magus
Moody Magus.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 10/20/30 seconds when defeating an opponent or using a MORTUARY CHARGE.
Moody Magus.sa2: Gain 1/1.5/2% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while benefiting from a BUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Moody is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to her access to Signature Ability Meter Gain, can be ignored.

Moonstruck.name: Moonstruck
Moonstruck.sa1: Inflict WITHER for 10 seconds and gain 10/12/15% STAR POWER meter when landing a CRITICAL HIT with a projectile.
Moonstruck.sa2: Once per match when activating STAR POWER at full meter, REVIVE and HEAL teammates by 50/75/100% of Annie's missing HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Moonstruck is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.
Sagan Beam: Reliable tool for self-healing. Also helps Moonstruck build up STAR POWER quickly and consistently with more chances for CRITICAL HITS.
Pillar of Creation: Annie's highest damage single-hit BLOCKBUSTER (if it crits). Great to do a high burst of damage and often used for BLOCKBUSTER kills or used as a combo extender.
Gravity Slingshot: Long multi-hit BLOCKBUSTER. Helps Moonstruck build up STAR POWER quickly and consistently with more chances for CRITICAL HITS.

Crescent Cut: Single-hit PROJECTILE move. Can be used for a chance of extra STAR POWER, but not highly recommended. When used in STAR POWER, Crescent Cut hits a total of 3 times, helping inflict GUARD BREAK and more reliably give extra STAR POWER.

Destruction Pillar: Annie's best SPECIAL MOVE, able to combo into itself, deal high bursts of damage, invincible on start-up and the added ability to deal extra damage if it is a CRITICAL HIT. Not STAR POWER reliant for damage or utility, so it helps Moonstruck maintain her STAR POWER for longer.

Ms. Trial.name: Ms. Trial
Ms. Trial.sa1: When HITTING an attacking opponent, remove 1 of the opponent's BUFFS and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION.
Ms. Trial.sa2: PRECISION HITS have a 50/75/100% chance to ignore the opponent's DEFENSE and ARMOR.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Ms. Trial is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Ms. Trial overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Mummy Dearest.name: Mummy Dearest
Mummy Dearest.sa1: Using a SPECIAL MOVE sacrifices 10% of Eliza's MAX HEALTH to gain 15/25/35% BLOCKBUSTER METER and HEAVY REGEN for 10 seconds.
Mummy Dearest.sa2: Gain BLESSING and IMMUNITY for 20/25/30 seconds each when entering SEKHMET MODE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Mummy Dearest is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Mummy Dearest has Meter Gain in her own Signature ability.

Myst-Match.name: Myst-Match
Myst-Match.sa1: While sharing the opponent’s same element, gain 1 stack of PRECISION every 3/2/1 second(s) and all HITS deal 100% bonus DAMAGE.
Myst-Match.sa2: Double’s PRECISION HITS deal 1/1.5/2% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent’s teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Myst-Match is best built with Attack, Meter Gain, Special Cooldown and Piercing.
Special investment: Players can invest in Crit Damage to take the most use of her PRECISION.

Nail Biter.name: Nail Biter
Nail Biter.sa1: Gain MIASMA or BARRIER for 15 seconds each every 0.5/0.3/0.25 seconds while charging WYRM'S TAIL.
Nail Biter.sa2: While fully CHARGED, EVADE all attacks while DASHING. Successful DASH ATTACKS inflict 1/2/3 random DEBUFFS (excluding STUN or DOOM) for 10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Nail Biter is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Meter Gain may be redundant due to her easy access to MIASMA. Investing in Accuracy ensures that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the opponent.

Near Death.name: Near Death
Near Death.sa1: Transfer 1 DEBUFF from yourself to the opponent and inflict GUARD BREAK for 15 seconds after every 7/6/5 seconds while not suffering a HIT (including blocked HITS).
Near Death.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from a DEBUFF, grant DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER. Also while the opponent has 3 or more stacks of GUARD BREAK, BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Near Death is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted by enemies. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will also increase her overall damage.

Nearly Departed.name: Nearly Departed
Nearly Departed.sa1: When using a BLOCKBUSTER at an ODD COMBO COUNT, gain INVINCIBILITY for 5/6/8 seconds.
Nearly Departed.sa2: Also RESURRECT teammates with 15/20/25% HEALTH if Squigly is below 50% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Nearly Departed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, but players can choose to build Crit Rate and Crit Damage.

Necrobreaker.name: Necrobreaker
Necrobreaker.sa1: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, gain FINAL STAND for 5/10/15 seconds.
Necrobreaker.sa2: Gain 5/6/7% HEALTH per second while charging WYRM'S TAIL.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Necrobreaker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Neuromancer.name: Neuromancer
Neuromancer.sa1: Drain 5/7/10% BLOCKBUSTER METER for each non-BLOCKBUSTER HIT blocked by the opponent.
Neuromancer.sa2: 10/12/15% of damage dealt from a BLOCKBUSTER is also suffered by the opponent's teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Neuromancer is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further. Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her unmatched level of meter gain through her Signature Ability.

Night Terror.name: Night Terror
Night Terror.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of MIASMA for 10 seconds after every 4/3/2 seconds while far away from the opponent.
Night Terror.sa2: Inflict IMMOBILIZE and FATIGUE for 10 seconds each every 4/3/2 seconds while near the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Night Terror is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that defenders don't resist her DEBUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE.

Nightshade.name: Nightshade
Nightshade.sa1: Gain DEADEYE for 4/5/6 seconds whenever the opponent suffers a DEBUFF.
Nightshade.sa2: Sekhmet hits deal 50/75/100% bonus damage. Opponents defeated by Sekhmet hits cannot be revived.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Nightshade is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain is a useful stat that Nightshade may use so she can activate Sekhmet Mode more often for more damage and access to permakill.

Ninja Star.name: Ninja Star
Ninja Star.sa1: 50/75/100% chance when hitting an attacking opponent to remove 1 opponent BUFF and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10 seconds.
Ninja Star.sa2: Projectiles deal 25/35/50% bonus damage for each DEBUFF applied to the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Ninja Star is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted by enemies. Meter gain allows her to use her stronger, more projectile based attacks more often.

No Egrets.name: No Egrets
No Egrets.sa1: On CRITICAL HIT, DISABLE the opponent’s BLOCKBUSTERS, SPECIAL MOVES, and TAG-INS for 4/5/6 seconds.
No Egrets.sa2: While Parasoul is alive, increase the active Fighter’s ACCURACY by 3/4/5% per CRITICAL HIT until the COMBO ends (up to 30/40/50%).

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, No Egrets is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and No Egrets inflicting her DEBUFFS.

Noble Mogul.name: Noble Mogul
Noble Mogul.sa1: While Eliza is alive, all teammates gain BARRIER every 30/25/20 seconds.
Noble Mogul.sa2: While Eliza is alive, all LIGHT teammates deal 5/10/15% bonus damage for each stack of BARRIER applied to them. Also Eliza gains IMMUNITY while benefiting from BARRIER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Noble Mogul is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Similar to Scarlet Viper, Noble Mogul too can be built with Crit Rate and Crit Damage. These stats, combined with her Signature Ability, let her deal incredible damage for an Eliza.

Number Cruncher.name: Number Cruncher
Number Cruncher.sa1: 25/35/50% chance to gain 1 stack of BLESSING for 20 seconds every 5 COMBO HITS.
Number Cruncher.sa2: When reaching 5 stacks of BLESSING, remove all BLESSINGS and inflict 5 stacks of GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Number Cruncher is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often, while Accuracy will increase the chances of her gaining BLESSING, while also ensuring that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted.

Number One.name: Number One
Number One.sa1: Gain DEADEYE and HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds each when activating HYPE MODE.
Number One.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE for 15 seconds while benefiting from HASTE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Number One is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown

Special Investment: As he naturally gains HASTE, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain, as Meter Gain caps at 100%. Crit Rate and Crit Damage are optional stats which players can invest in to further enhance his offensive potential.

Nunsense.name: Nunsense
Nunsense.sa1: When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, gain 1/2/3 random BUFFS for 10 seconds any time the opponent gains a BUFF.
Nunsense.sa2: When at an ELEMENTAL ADVANTAGE, inflict 1/2/3 random DEBUFFS for 10 seconds after suffering any DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Nunsense is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Nyanotech.name: Nyanotech
Nyanotech.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING and BARRIER for 8/10/12 seconds each when launching a HEADRONE
Nyanotech.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER and about to suffer a DEBUFF, 50/75/100% chance to prevent it and gain ENRAGE for 12 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Nyanotech is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage. Meter Gain will allow her to use her BLOCKBUSTERS more often.

Octoplasm.name: Octoplasm
Octoplasm.sa1: When TAGGING to or from Marie, the incoming Fighter gains 2 stacks of REGEN for 15 seconds and 10/12/15% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Octoplasm.sa2: While Marie is alive, WATER teammates’ hits have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict BLEED, SLIME, or QUIETUS for 15 seconds each while benefiting from REGEN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive support Marie, Octoplasm is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy and Tag Cooldown are optional stats to build on her that will allow her to be more consistent on and off the field.

Ogre Achiever.name: Ogre Achiever
Ogre Achiever.sa1: When the opponent attempts to gain a BUFF, Beowulf has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds.
Ogre Achiever.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, BLOCKBUSTERS have a 50/75/100% chance to grant permanent ENRAGE and heal for 10% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Ogre Achiever is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat to build on Ogre Achiever, as this gives him a 75% chance to deny opponents buffs at 50% Accuracy. Meter Gain is also a recommended stat to build on him, but it can be ignored if used with a taunt.

Oh Mai.name: Oh Mai
Oh Mai.sa1: Gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 15/17/20 seconds and 5 stacks of PRECISION after defeating an opponent.
Oh Mai.sa2: When any fighter is defeated, all teammates gain 2 stacks of ENRAGE for 7/10/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Oh Mai is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

One Up.name: One Up
One Up.sa1: For every 8 COMBO HITS landed, gain DEADEYE for 5/7/10 seconds and BARRIER.
One Up.sa2: When reaching 8, 16, 32 and 64 COMBO HITS, reduce opponent's CURRENT HEALTH and BLOCKBUSTER METER by .5/.75/1% for each current COMBO HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, One Up is best built with Attack, Piercing and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Players can build Crit Rate and Crit Damage to further increase his damage output. Special Cooldown is also recommended.
preferred_moveset: Tympani Drive / Strike Up the Band

Overclocked.name: Overclocked
Overclocked.sa1: Gain PRECISION and BARRIER after every 5/4/3 seconds not suffering a hit (includes blocked hits).
Overclocked.sa2: All attacks are UNBLOCKABLE while at 5/4/3 or more stacks of PRECISION, and 50% of incoming damage is reflected while at 5/4/3 or more stacks of BARRIER.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used offense, Overclocked is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, she is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: On offense Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her PRECISION.

Palace Plunderer.name: Palace Plunderer
Palace Plunderer.sa1: Gain EVASION for 7 seconds and grant all teammates 1/2/3% HEALTH every 5 seconds while not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits).
Palace Plunderer.sa2: Every 15/12/10 COMBO HITS while benefiting from a BUFF, transfer 1 opponent BUFF to self and grant teammates ENRAGE for 30 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Palace Plunderer is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Parasite Weave.name: Parasite Weave
Parasite Weave.sa1: 35% chance on CRITICAL HIT to gain MIASMA for 4/5/6 seconds. Also, while the opponent is not suffering from INVERSE POLARITY, inflict STUN for 3/3.5/4 seconds.
Parasite Weave.sa2: While the opponent is STUNNED, 25/30/35% chance on CRITICAL HIT to convert their STUN into INVERSE POLARITY for 8 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Parasite Weave is best built with ATK%, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Parasite Weave. Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS won't be resisted by enemies.

Patched Up.name: Patched Up
Patched Up.sa1: 8/12/15% chance when either Fighter is HIT (includes blocked hits) to transfer 1 opponent BUFF to Ms. Fortune.
Patched Up.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of any BUFFs, HITS (including blocked hits) inflict WITHER and CURSE for 4/7/10 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: Patched Up works as a mixed variant to play either offensively or defensively. As such, you can consider to build Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown for offence, or build her defensively with Health, Defence and Resistance
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her taking enemy BUFFS and reduce the chances that her DEBUFFS are resisted.

Pea Shooter.name: Pea Shooter
Pea Shooter.sa1: Projectiles deal 15/25/35% bonus damage for all teammates.
Pea Shooter.sa2: All projectiles have a 10/15% chance to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 3/6 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Pea Shooter is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting ARMOR BREAK.

Persona Assistant.name: Persona Assistant
Persona Assistant.sa1: Every 20 seconds while Robo-Fortune is alive, she gains 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION and 3/4/5 stacks of ENRAGE for 5 seconds. Her teammates also gain 1 stack of BLESSING and BARRIER.
Persona Assistant.sa2: 50/75/100% chance for DASH ATTACKS to be UNBLOCKABLE while benefiting from ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Persona Assistant is best built with Attack, Meter Gain, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will drastically improve her damage output while PRECISION is active, though because of the infrequency of her first Signature Ability, it may be ignored depending on player preference.

Phantom Threads.name: Phantom Threads
Phantom Threads.sa1: When the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN, Fukua gains BLESSING for 10/15/20 seconds and removes 1 opponents BUFF.
Phantom Threads.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, remove all BLESSINGS and gain ENRAGE for 10 seconds and heal for 5/7/10% HEALTH per BLESSING removed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Phantom Threads is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY.

Phantom Wrangler.name: Phantom Wrangler
Phantom Wrangler.sa1: HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal 30% BONUS DAMAGE and have a 50% chance to inflict SLIME for 10/12/15 seconds.
Phantom Wrangler.sa2: Drain 2/3/4% BLOCKBUSTER METER per stack of SLIME on the opponent when they BOUNCE off a wall.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Phantom Wrangler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the opponent.

Pickle Baller.name: Pickle Baller
Pickle Baller.sa1: While Beowulf is alive, the active fighter gains EVASION for 7 seconds and 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Pickle Baller.sa2: When any teammate EVADES an attack, grant REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds and 2 stacks of PRECISION.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Pickle Baller is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: To get the most use out of his PRECISION, Crit Damage is recommended to be built on Pickle Baller. If used with a taunt, Meter Gain can also be avoided.

Plot Twisted.name: Plot Twisted
Plot Twisted.sa1: Reflect 10% of all damage taken per DEBUFF on Squigly (max: 40%). Also, once per match, RESURRECT with 25/35/50% HEALTH and 4 random DEBUFFS for 15 seconds each.
Plot Twisted.sa2: Suffer a random DEBUFF for 4/6/8 seconds every 4 seconds. Squigly’s NON-BLOCKBUSTER HITS deal 1% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent per DEBUFF on either Fighter (max 3%).

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Squigly, Plot Twisted is best built with HP, Meter Gain, and Defense.
Special investment: Crit Resist can be used to prolong Plot Twisted's health, and extend fights

Poltergust.name: Poltergust
Poltergust.sa1: Using a BLOCKBUSTER inflicts SLIME on the opponent for 10 seconds. BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage to opponents suffering SLIME.
Poltergust.sa2: When a BUFF on either Fighter expires or is removed, gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Poltergust is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Meter Gain is a stat that can either be beneficial or absolutely redundant depending on one thing; If the fight features a decent amount of BUFFS with timers. If that isn't the case, then Meter Gain is a good stat to use, as Poltergust is a variant who relies on her Blockbusters for damage, but if that IS the case, then she will have frequent access to her Blockbusters regardless and be better off using a different stat. As a result, it is recommended to have two sets of moves; One of them with Meter Gain included, and one where it isn't, switching between the two depending on player/enemy team compositions and Modifiers.

Primal Prodigy.name: Primal Prodigy
Primal Prodigy.sa1: Gain 1 random BUFF for 10 seconds and 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER every 6/5/4 seconds while not suffering a HIT (includes blocked hits).
Primal Prodigy.sa2: When a BUFF on Peacock expires, inflict CURSE and DISABLE opponent SPECIAL MOVES for 6/7/8 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Primal Prodigy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by defenders.

Primed.name: Primed
Primed.sa1: Gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when spawning a TEAR.
Primed.sa2: Detonated TEARS inflict BLEED for 3/4/5 seconds on HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Primed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Princess Pride.name: Princess Pride
Princess Pride.sa1: Gain REGEN for 4/5/6 seconds and BARRIER when spawning a TEAR.
Princess Pride.sa2: On TEAR DETONATION, consume all stacks of BARRIER and immediately recover 2/4/6% HEALTH per active TEAR. The detonated TEARS also deal 20% bonus damage per stack consumed.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Princess Pride is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Prism Plumage.name: Prism Plumage
Prism Plumage.sa1: While Peacock is alive, all teammates TAG IN with 2 BUFFS based on their ELEMENTS for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).
Prism Plumage.sa2: While Peacock is alive, all projectiles have a 10% chance to inflict DEBUFFS based on the opponent's ELEMENT for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Prism Plumage is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her teammates inflicting DEBUFFS.

Private Dick.name: Private Dick
Private Dick.sa1: 5% chance on HIT to STUN opponent for 2/2.5/3 seconds. Also, BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50% BONUS DAMAGE against opponents suffering from STUN.
Private Dick.sa2: When Big Band is about to suffer a DEBUFF, he has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain ENRAGE for 8 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Private Dick is best built with Attack, Piercing and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Accuracy is recommended for Private Dick to activate his SA more reliably and that his DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies.

Proton Pulse.name: Proton Pulse
Proton Pulse.sa1: 20% chance on HIT to inflict POWER SURGE for 10/15/20 seconds on both fighters while near the opponent. Non-BLOCKBUSTER HITS grant 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Proton Pulse.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain ENRAGE, REGEN, or EVASION for 10/15/20 seconds per stack of POWER SURGE on both fighters and remove all POWER SURGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Proton is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies while being able to gain more BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Prototype.name: Prototype
Prototype.sa1: BLOCKBUSTER HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict POWER SURGE for 10 seconds.
Prototype.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, gain 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Prototype is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage. Meter Gain can be ignored due to Prototype's inherent ability to gain Blockbuster meter from her Signature Ability.

Psycommander.name: Psycommander
Psycommander.sa1: When FIRING your last remaining SHOT, gain FINAL STAND and 3/4/5 stacks of ENRAGE for 10 seconds each.
Psycommander.sa2: Gain DEADEYE and 1/2/3 stack(s) of EVASION for 10 seconds each when using a SPECIAL MOVE while benefiting from ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Psycommander is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Psykid.name: Psykid
Psykid.sa1: When HITTING an attacking opponent, gain DEADEYE and inflict INVERSE POLARITY for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Psykid.sa2: 50/75/100% chance to reset the timers of all Umbrella's BUFFS and all opponent DEBUFFS except STUN and DOOM when the opponent BOUNCES off a wall.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Psykid is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her INVERSE POLARITY is not resisted by enemies.

Puddle Pirate.name: Puddle Pirate
Puddle Pirate.sa1: PUDDLE HITS remove 1/2/3 opponent BUFFS and inflict IMMOBILIZE for 10 seconds.
Puddle Pirate.sa2: While the opponent has no BUFFS, PUDDLE HITS grant ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Puddle Pirate is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Purrfect Dark.name: Purrfect Dark
Purrfect Dark.sa1: After facing Ms. Fortune for 15/12/10 seconds, the opponent suffers DEATH MARK and CURSE.
Purrfect Dark.sa2: HEAD HITS have a 10% chance to instantly defeat enemies if they are suffering from DEATH MARK and are below 25/35/50% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Purrfect Dark is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will increase her overall damage by taking use of her DEATH MARK. And Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the enemy, while also increasing the chances of her second Signature Ability activating.

Purrminator.name: Purrminator
Purrminator.sa1: 10/12/15% chance to gain 1 stack of PRECISION and inflict DEATH MARK for 10 seconds when the opponent BLOCKS a HIT.
Purrminator.sa2: Each CRITICAL HIT permanently increases DAMAGE by 1/2/3%.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Purrminator is best built with Meter Gain, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Rate is the most important stat for Purrminator, while Crit Damage will increase her overall damage. Despite being an offensive Robo-Fortune, Attack isn't a priority due to Purrminator's SA damage increase being applied to the base ATK stat rather than the base ATK + move stat increases.

Pyro-Technique.name: Pyro-Technique
Pyro-Technique.sa1: BLOCKBUSTER and SPECIAL MOVE HITS have a 20% chance to inflict WITHER and BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.
Pyro-Technique.sa2: 20% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds if the opponent is suffering from WITHER or BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Pyro-Technique is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting WITHER, BLEED and gaining ENRAGE.

Rage Appropriate.name: Rage Appropriate
Rage Appropriate.sa1: Gain permanent ENRAGE when suffering a HIT (including blocked hits) that deals more than 10/7/5% MAX HEALTH.
Rage Appropriate.sa2: Every 15/12/10th COMBO HIT grants HEAVY REGEN and 2 stacks of ARMOR for 10 seconds each.

Rain Shadow.name: Rain Shadow
Rain Shadow.sa1: 15% chance when landing a HIT (including BLOCKED HITS) to inflict ARMOR BREAK and POWER SURGE for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Rain Shadow.sa2: Every 5 seconds while Fukua is on the opponent’s side of the stage and while not STUNNED, opponents lose all current BUFFS and suffer STUN for 2/3/4 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rain Shadow is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of Rain Shadow inflicting her debuffs and stops defenders from resisting STUN.

Rainbow Blight.name: Rainbow Blight
Rainbow Blight.sa1: When TRANSMUTING, gain BUFFS based on the resulting ELEMENT for 7/8/10 seconds.
Rainbow Blight.sa2: When TRANSMUTING, inflict DEBUFFS based on the resulting ELEMENT for 7/8/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Nunsense is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: no Special Investment is needed for this fighter.

Raining Champ.name: Raining Champ
Raining Champ.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, the active Fighter gains 1 stack of BLESSING and UNFLINCHING for 15 seconds every 20/15/10 COMBO HITS.
Raining Champ.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, increase all teammates' ATTACK by 2/3/4% of the Fighter's CURRENT HEALTH for each stack of BLESSING currently on the Fighter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Raining Champ is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: HP is another stat you can build on Raining Champ as it synergizes well with her Signature Ability. If built critless, HP should be focused above Attack as it provides her with more damage.

Raw Nerv.name: Raw Nerv
Raw Nerv.sa1: Gain FINAL STAND for 15 seconds and inflict permanent DEATHMARK when your HEALTH drops below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Raw Nerv.sa2: While benefiting from FINAL STAND, 5/7/10% chance on HIT to gain ENRAGE and 50% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Raw Nerv is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to take the most out of her DEATHMARK.

Red Rider.name: Red Rider
Red Rider.sa1: STANDARD SHOTS inflict WITHER and HEAL BLOCK for 10/12/15 seconds each while near an opponent.
Red Rider.sa2: 25/35/50% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH while the opponent is suffering from HEAL BLOCK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Red Rider is best built with Attack and Special Cooldown. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.

Special investment: Players are advised not to invest in Crit Rate and Crit Damage, as Red Rider's signature ability is perfect to counter Painwheels's TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability and Black Dahlia variants with NO TIME TO DIE. With these, players can also avoid unlocking the Crit Rate and Crit Damage nodes in her skill tree. Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs are not resisted by enemies, and investing in Meter Gain will allow Red Rider to spam her Tier 3 Blockbuster more often.

Red Velvet.name: Red Velvet
Red Velvet.sa1: Inflict HEX for 10/12/15 seconds when entering Sekhmet Mode, disabling opponent SIGNATURE ABILITIES for the duration of the effect.
Red Velvet.sa2: If an opponent TAGS OUT while suffering from HEX, the next opponent will be inflicted with 3 random DEBUFFS for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Red Velvet is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Red Velvet to use her Signature Ability more often.

Regally Blonde.name: Regally Blonde
Regally Blonde.sa1: 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE and reduce the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER by 25/35/50% when either Fighter uses a BLOCKBUSTER.
Regally Blonde.sa2: While near an opponent, DISABLE their SPECIAL MOVES and gain AUTO-BLOCK every 4/3/2 seconds. Both effects are removed when no longer near an opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Regally Blonde is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage. If build defensively she is best built with HP, Resistance, Defense and Meter Gain.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS.

Reimaged.name: Reimaged
Reimaged.sa1: The 1st COMBO HIT landed on Robo-Fortune converts 1 opponent BUFF into a random DEBUFF and grants ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds each.
Reimaged.sa2: When defeated or DETONATING, reduce the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER by 100%. Also once per match, RESURRECT with 15/20/25% HEALTH and gain permanent REGEN and ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Robo-Fortune, Reimaged is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Resistance and Defense.
Special investment: One can invest in Crit Resist to further reduce the damage she receives.

Rerun.name: Rerun
Rerun.sa1: All teammates TAG IN with ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds.
Rerun.sa2: COOLDOWN for TAG INS reduced by 25/35/50% for all teammates.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Rerun is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Tag Cooldown will synergize with her Signature Ability.

Resonant Evil.name: Resonant Evil
Resonant Evil.sa1: Getting HIT has a 10% chance to grant ARMOR for 5/7/10 seconds.
Resonant Evil.sa2: 5% chance when HIT to STUN the opponent for 3/4/5 seconds while benefitting from ARMOR.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Resonant Evil is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Players are recommended to build Accuracy on Resonant Evil to increase the chances of gaining ARMOR and inflicting STUN.

Rhythm Rider.name: Rhythm Rider
Rhythm Rider.sa1: While Big Band is alive, all teammates gain HASTE and REGEN for 6/8/10 seconds after every 15 seconds.
Rhythm Rider.sa2: While benefiting from HASTE and REGEN, DASH ATTACKS inflict CURSE. Also when Big Band or any teammate gains a BUFF while the opponent is suffering from CURSE, its duration is increased by 3/4/5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Rhythm Rider is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Players are advised to build Accuracy so that his CURSE is not resisted by Defenders, and be more likely to provide HEAVY REGEN and HASTE for himself and teammates alike.

Risky Ginger.name: Risky Ginger
Risky Ginger.sa1: Inflict DEATH MARK for 10/12/15 seconds and gain ENRAGE when HITTING an attacking opponent. A stack of ENRAGE is removed after each BLOCKED HIT.
Risky Ginger.sa2: With at least 5/4/3 stacks of ENRAGE, BLOCKBUSTERS become UNBLOCKABLE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Risky Ginger is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output by taking maximum use out of her DEATHMARK

Robocopy.name: Robocopy
Robocopy.sa1: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, gain 1/2/3 stacks of ARMOR and BARRIER. ARMOR lasts for 10 seconds.
Robocopy.sa2: For each 20% HEALTH lost by either Fighter, gain ENRAGE for 15 seconds and 15/20/25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Robocopy is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance. If built offensively, Robocopy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: If built offensively, the recommended stat for Robocopy is Meter Gain, as this combined with his second Signature Ability allows him to quickly spam Blockbusters.

Rock Star.name: Rock Star
Rock Star.sa1: While Filia is alive, teammates TAG IN with 1/2/3 stacks of BARRIER for 10 seconds.
Rock Star.sa2: When any teammate's BARRIER expires, they gain FINAL STAND for 10 seconds and 10/15/20% METER for all BLOCKBUSTERS.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Bad Hair Day is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, as she is mainly a support.

Rogue Agent.name: Rogue Agent
Rogue Agent.sa1: Each HEAD HIT has a 25% chance to TRANSFER 1 opponent BUFF and convert it into 1/2/3 stack(s) of PRECISION.
Rogue Agent.sa2: PRECISION HITS grant EVASION and inflict DEATH MARK for 5/7/10 seconds. Each stack of EVASION is removed after an evaded HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Rogue Agent is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Crit Damage will increase Rogue Agent overall damage by taking use of her PRECISION. Accuracy will also increase the chances of her stealing BUFFS and will ensure that her DEATH MARK isn't resisted by enemies.

Rose-Tinted.name: Rose-Tinted
Rose-Tinted.sa1: While Umbrella is alive, all teammates gain 1 stack each of BARRIER and THORNS for 5/7/10 seconds for every 25% HEALTH lost.
Rose-Tinted.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, she clears all teammate DEBUFFS every 30/25/20 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Umbrella, Rose-Tinted is best built with HP, Resistance, Meter Gain and Defense.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Rough Copy.name: Rough Copy
Rough Copy.sa1: Any teammate gains permanent HASTE after facing an opponent with the same ELEMENT for 10/7/5 seconds.
Rough Copy.sa2: Any teammate inflicts permanent SLOW after facing an opponent of the same CHARACTER TYPE for 10/7/5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rough Copy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Rusty.name: Rusty
Rusty.sa1: 5/7/10% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3 seconds.
Rusty.sa2: Also converts 1/2/3 of the opponent's BUFFS into BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Rusty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED and converting BUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Salty.name: Salty
Salty.sa1: Once per match, gain BLESSING and 3 stacks of ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when falling below 35% HEALTH.
Salty.sa2: While benefiting from ENRAGE, THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict BLEED for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Salty is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting BLEED.

Sawed Apart.name: Sawed Apart
Sawed Apart.sa1: SPECIAL MOVE and BLOCKBUSTER HITS have a 25/30/35% chance to inflict a random DEBUFF for 10 seconds. These debuffs are removed if Painwheel is knocked down.
Sawed Apart.sa2: While Painwheel is the active Fighter, when a DEBUFF on the opponent expires, deal damage equal to 1/2/3% of their MAX HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Sawed Apart is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting DEBUFFS. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output.

Scale Tipper.name: Scale Tipper
Scale Tipper.sa1: While Filia has more BUFFS or fewer DEBUFFS than the opponent, transfer 1 opponent BUFF every 2 seconds and inflict 1 random DEBUFF every second for 7 seconds.
Scale Tipper.sa2: When the current number of BUFFS and DEBUFFS between both Fighters is more than or equal to 17, the opponent suffers permanent DOOM for 10 seconds, bypassing all DEBUFF preventing effects.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Scale Tipper is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will allow her to activate her inflict DEBUFFS more reliably, and not be negated by the Resistance stat on enemies.

Scare Giver.name: Scare Giver
Scare Giver.sa1: Inflict WITHER and grant HASTE for 6/7/8 seconds each when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.
Scare Giver.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to grant ENRAGE for 10 seconds and to DRAIN 3/4/5% HEALTH from the opponent while benefiting from HASTE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Scare Giver is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Scare Giver, as it increases the chances of her second Signature Ability activating. Due to her access to HASTE, Meter Gain can be ignored.

Scared Stiff.name: Scared Stiff
Scared Stiff.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING after facing the same opponent for 25/20/15 seconds. UNFLINCHING is removed when the opponent TAGS OUT or dies.
Scared Stiff.sa2: Cannot suffer more than 15/10/5% HEALTH from a single HIT.

stat_investment: General Investment: If built offensively, Scared Stiff is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. If built defensively, she needs HP, Defense, Resistance and Meter Gain.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Scarlet Viper.name: Scarlet Viper
Scarlet Viper.sa1: Inflict BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds on both Fighters when entering Sekhmet Mode.
Scarlet Viper.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Scarlet Viper is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Scarlet Viper to use her Signature Ability more often. As a rare case, Scarlet Viper is an Eliza who's best build with Crit Rate and Crit Damage. These stats not only make her an Eliza with one of the highest damage ceilings but also lets her use fighters like Seraph Soldier as teammates to recover lost HP

Scrub.name: Scrub
Scrub.sa1: All teammates instantly recover 5/10/15% HEALTH when Valentine TAGS OUT.
Scrub.sa2: Teammates in reserve regenerate SCRATCH DAMAGE and gain BLOCKBUSTER meter 50/75/100% faster.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Scrub is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Sea Witch.name: Sea Witch
Sea Witch.sa1: Using a BLOCKBUSTER inflicts CURSE and GUARD BREAK for 6/8/10 seconds each.
Sea Witch.sa2: Using a SPECIAL MOVE grants HASTE and DEADEYE for 6/8/10 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Sea Witch is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Special Cooldown is an important stat for her, as it allows her to keep a constant loop of DEADEYE and HASTE. Meter Gain should be completely ignored due to her access to HASTE.

Seraph Soldier.name: Seraph Soldier
Seraph Soldier.sa1: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter gains ENRAGE for 10 seconds when dealing at least 10% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH from a single HIT. Also, your active Fire Element Fighter permanently increases DAMAGE by 0.25/0.35/0.5% every second.
Seraph Soldier.sa2: While Valentine is alive, 15/20/25% of all damage inflicted by the active Fighter's CRITICAL HITS is regained as HEALTH while that Fighter is benefiting from ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Seraph Soldier is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Serpent Sin.name: Serpent Sin
Serpent Sin.sa1: SPECIAL MOVE HITS heal for 5/7/10% of Double’s MAX HEALTH.
Serpent Sin.sa2: Gain MIASMA for 3/4/5 seconds when the opponent gains a BUFF or suffers a DEBUFF while Double’s HEALTH is higher than the opponent’s.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Serpent Sin is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Special Cooldown is an important stat to help Serpent Sin heal more often.
Critless investment: Due to the nature of her Signature Ability and Moves, you may avoid giving Serpent Sin Crit Rate if you have the correct setup.

Shadow Ops.name: Shadow Ops
Shadow Ops.sa1: Opponents suffer CURSE after 3/2/1 seconds while near a TEAR.
Shadow Ops.sa2: Gain THORNS every 3/2/1 seconds while near a TEAR.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Shadow Ops is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that she can inflict CURSE reliably.

Shadow Puppet.name: Shadow Puppet
Shadow Puppet.sa1: 3/4/5% chance on HIT to reset the timers of all Fukua's BUFFS and all opponent DEBUFFS.
Shadow Puppet.sa2: Once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, freeze time for 7 seconds and gain 3/4/5 stacks of MIASMA for 7 seconds. Time resumes if Fukua attacks.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Shadow Puppet is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more damage when using moves like LOBS OF LOVE or TWICE SHY.

Shear Force.name: Shear Force
Shear Force.sa1: When either Fighter suffers a DEBUFF, gain 10% BLOCKBUSTER METER and gain BLESSING and AUTO-BLOCK for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Shear Force.sa2: When using a BLOCKBUSTER, inflict QUIETUS for 15 seconds and deal 10/12/15% bonus damage per BUFF applied to Filia. Also opponents defeated by BLOCKBUSTERS cannot be revived.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Shear Force is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS will not be resisted by enemies. Crit Rate and Crit Damage will improve her damage as well.

Sheltered.name: Sheltered
Sheltered.sa1: Increases CRIT RATE by 10/15/20% for all teammates.
Sheltered.sa2: On CRITICAL HIT, gain ENRAGE for 5/6/7 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Sheltered is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Crit Rate will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating and Sheltered gaining ENRAGE.

Silent Kill.name: Silent Kill
Silent Kill.sa1: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to REMOVE all DEBUFFS from self.
Silent Kill.sa2: 15/20/25% chance on HIT to REMOVE all opponent BUFFS.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Silent Kill is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Sketchy.name: Sketchy
Sketchy.sa1: While Peacock is alive, all teammates TAG IN with HASTE and IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).
Sketchy.sa2: While Peacock is alive, all opponents TAG IN with SLOW and CURSE for 5/7/10 seconds (except after teammate death).

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Sketchy is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies.

Snake Bite.name: Snake Bite
Snake Bite.sa1: Gain 1/2/3 stacks of EVASION and 25% BLOCKBUSTER METER when activating HYPE MODE.
Snake Bite.sa2: Gain permanent HASTE and 3/4/5 stacks of BARRIER when defeating an opponent while in HYPE MODE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Snake Bite is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Due to his access to HASTE, meter gain can largely be avoided. Crit Damage is also recommended to be built on Snake Bite if you are using the HURTING HURDLE Special Move.

Snake Charmer.name: Snake Charmer
Snake Charmer.sa1: Using a SPECIAL MOVE grants 10/15/20% MORTUARY CHARGE and inflicts IMMOBILIZE and DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 10 seconds each. When becoming fully CHARGED, also gain ENRAGE.
Snake Charmer.sa2: When using a MORTUARY CHARGE, all teammates gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER every second and permanent ENRAGE for the rest of the match.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Snake Charmer is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by the opponent.

Solar Flair.name: Solar Flair
Solar Flair.sa2: When activating STAR POWER at full meter, gain permanent HASTE, 3/4/5 stacks of permanent ENRAGE, but suffer FATIGUE for 5 seconds. All effects are removed when exiting STAR POWER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Solar Flair is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

Solid Gold.name: Solid Gold
Solid Gold.sa1: Every 15 seconds, permanently increase Attack by 25/30/35% and Crit Rate by 10/15/20% (even while benched).
Solid Gold.sa2: When either Fighter lands a CRITICAL HIT, 30/40/50% chance to gain ENRAGE and BLESSING for 10 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Solid Gold is recommended to build Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. Note that Attack increases from moves will not influence how much Attack is gained from Solid Gold's first Signature Ability.

Special investment: Crit Damage will help take advantage of the boosted Crit Rate and Attack that Solid Gold will receive overtime. Some Crit Rate may be recommended to build just to activate her 2nd Signature Ability faster, but it is not mandatory.
preferred_moveset: BANG, BANG, BANG! / Hi Hi Birdie

Soul Crusher.name: Soul Crusher
Soul Crusher.sa1: Gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds each whenever the opponent gains a BUFF.
Soul Crusher.sa2: Deal 5/7/10% bonus damage for each BUFF or DEBUFF applied to the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Soul Crusher is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK is not resisted by enemies.

Soulbound.name: Soulbound
Soulbound.sa1: While not in STAR POWER and not benefiting from EVASION, well-timed BLOCKS grant 30/40/50% STAR POWER meter, 1/2/3 stack(s) of BARRIER, and allows Annie to EVADE all attacks for 3 seconds.
Soulbound.sa2: When activating STAR POWER, sacrifice 35% of MAX HEALTH to gain DEADEYE for 10/12/15 seconds. While in STAR POWER, BENCHED opponents suffer HEX and ALL opponents lose 1/2/3% HEALTH every second.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Soulbound is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: This variant does not need any Special Investment, but players may choose to invest in HP to get the most use out of her BARRIER.

Souls Sister.name: Souls Sister
Souls Sister.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while far away from the opponent.
Souls Sister.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds when landing a HIT while far away from the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Fukua, Rough Copy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow Soul Sisters to deal more damage.

Space Case.name: Space Case
Space Case.sa1: While RAVENOUS, inflict DOOM for 15 seconds when an opponent's HEALTH drops below 25/35/50%. DOOM is removed if Umbrella TAGS OUT or is defeated.
Space Case.sa2: When defeating an opponent, gain 3 stacks of PRECISION and 3 stacks of a BUFF determined by the opponent's ELEMENT for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Space Case is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DOOM is not resisted by defenders.

Spell-Bent.name: Spell-Bent
Spell-Bent.sa1: SKELETAL SUMMON MOVES grant either REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds or BARRIER.
Spell-Bent.sa2: While benefiting from REGEN and BARRIER, HITS from SKELETAL SUMMONS deal an additional 1/1.5/2% of the opponent's MAX HEALTH and DRAIN 3% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Marie, Spell-Bent is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant, but players can choose to build HP to take the most use out of her BARRIER.

Splitting Image.name: Splitting Image
Splitting Image.sa1: While HEALTH% is lower than the opponent's, gain permanent IMMUNITY and recover 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second.
Splitting Image.sa2: Gain 5% BLOCKBUSTER METER and 1 stack of PRECISION after every 5/4/3 seconds while facing a Fukua, Filia, or a Light Element opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Splitting Image is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she should be built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: When used on offense, Crit Damage will allow her to deal through her stacks of PRECISION.

Stage Fright.name: Stage Fright
Stage Fright.sa1: The opponent suffers CURSE and HEX for 10/12/15 seconds when dropping below 25% HEALTH.
Stage Fright.sa2: Inflict a 30/25/20 second DOOM when defeated with a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Stage Fright is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs aren't resisted by defenders.

Stand Out.name: Stand Out
Stand Out.sa1: 50/60/75% of all damage inflicted is regained as HEALTH as long as Eliza's health percentage is lower than her opponent's (also applies on Blocked hits).
Stand Out.sa2: When the opponent attempts to gain a BUFF, Eliza has a 25/35/50% chance to prevent it and gain 25% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Stand Out is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: It is recommended that players don't invest in Meter Gain, as Stand Out has Meter Gain in her own Signature ability. However, when used against an opponent that might not gain a lot of buffs, Meter Gain could still be useful.

Star Child.name: Star Child
Star Child.sa1: Each HIT blocked has a 10% chance to inflict GUARD BREAK and ARMOR BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds.
Star Child.sa2: SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS deal 15/25/35% bonus damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Star Child is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase the chances of her inflicting GUARD BREAK.

Star Shine.name: Star Shine
Star Shine.sa1: Gain a random BUFF for 8/10/12 seconds every 4 seconds. Also, gain 8/9/10% STAR POWER for each BUFF gained by either Fighter while not in STAR POWER MODE.
Star Shine.sa2: Remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY for 5/7/10 seconds and permanent PRECISION when activating STAR POWER MODE at full meter. Permanent PRECISION is removed when an opponent is defeated.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Star Shine is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: Investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage. Crit Rate is an optional stat which players can choose to invest in as her PRECISION will not be used during the beginning of the match.

Star-Crossed.name: Star-Crossed
Star-Crossed.sa1: Well-timed BLOCKS STUN the opponent for 3/4/5 seconds and inflict GUARD BREAK. GUARD BREAK is removed when Parasoul TAGS OUT.
Star-Crossed.sa2: BLOCKBUSTERS deal 50/75/100% bonus damage against opponents suffering from GUARD BREAK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Star-Crossed is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.

Special investment: Crit Rate will increase her damage output through synergy with her Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS. Accuracy may be used so STUN and GUARD BREAK can be more easily inflicted and counter defenders with Resistance.

Star-Spangled.name: Star-Spangled
Star-Spangled.sa1: Gain BARRIER and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10/12/15 seconds each when breaking or landing a THROW.
Star-Spangled.sa2: While benefiting from BARRIER and the opponent is in the air, 15/20/25% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED and FATIGUE for 7 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Star-Spangled is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy is the most important stat for Star-Spangled, as it ensures that defenders do not resist her debuffs.

Starlight Rose.name: Starlight Rose
Starlight Rose.sa1: While Annie is alive, all teammates' well-timed BLOCKS remove up to 2 DEBUFF(S) and grant BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds.
Starlight Rose.sa2: While Annie is alive, all teammates gain ENRAGE and REGEN for 5/6/7 seconds each every 3 seconds while benefiting from BARRIER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Starlight Rose is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often and punish the opponent.

Stellar Huntress.name: Stellar Huntress
Stellar Huntress.sa1: When RELOADING with 3 SHOTS or less remaining, gain 3 LIGHTNING SHOTS. LIGHTNING SHOTS DISABLE TAG INS and have a 10% chance to DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Stellar Huntress.sa2: While the opponent is suffering from DISABLE TAG IN, LIGHTNING SHOTS deal 0.5/1/1.5% MAX HEALTH as bonus damage to the opponent's teammates. While the opponent is suffering from DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS, deal an additional 0.5/1/1.5% MAX HEALTH to all opponents.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Stellar Huntress is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs are not resisted by enemies.

Stone Sentinel.name: Stone Sentinel
Stone Sentinel.sa1: While on Cerebella’s side of the stage, gain 40/50/60% damage reduction.
Stone Sentinel.sa2: While on the opponent’s side of the stage, the active Fighter gains 1 stack of BARRIER for 10 seconds every 10/7/5 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive variant, Stone Sentinel is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist can be a used to avoid the likes of DESTRUCTION PILLAR or FERAL EDGE doing fixed damage against Stone Sentinel's damage reduction.

Summer Salt.name: Summer Salt
Summer Salt.sa1: Opponents lose 1 BUFF and 1/2/3% HEALTH every 2 seconds while near a TEAR.
Summer Salt.sa2: When DETONATING at least 3 TEARS at once, REMOVE all DEBUFFS and gain 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION. The detonated TEARS also deal 100% BONUS DAMAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Parasoul, Summer Salt is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Damage and Special Cooldown. Do keep in mind that due to Parasoul's Marquee Ability CRITICAL MASS, Parasoul variants only need to build 100% Crit Damage.
Special investment: Meter Gain allow her to use Blockbusters more often.

Sundae School.name: Sundae School
