Sundae School.sa1: When any teammate inflicts a DEBUFF (excluding STUN), increase its duration by 1/2/3 second(s).
Sundae School.sa2: When any teammate suffers a DEBUFF (excluding STUN), reduce its duration by 1/2/3 second(s).

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Sundae School is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Superluminal.name: Superluminal
Superluminal.sa1: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter’s SPECIAL MOVE COOLDOWNS recharge 70/85/100% faster while dashing or back-dashing. Successful DASH ATTACKS instantly refresh TAG INS.
Superluminal.sa2: While Valentine is alive, the active Fighter’s first SPECIAL MOVE HIT of a combo grants all teammates EVASION and the first BLOCKBUSTER HIT grants all teammates HASTE for 5/6/7 seconds each.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Superluminal is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Surgeon General.name: Surgeon General
Surgeon General.sa1: While Valentine is alive, she gains a permanent ENRAGE every 60/45/30 seconds.
Surgeon General.sa2: While Valentine is alive, teammates gain IMMUNITY and HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds every 30 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Surgeon General is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Temple Tyrant.name: Temple Tyrant
Temple Tyrant.sa1: Double's THROWS grant ARMOR for 20 seconds and remove 1/2/3 DEBUFFS from herself.
Temple Tyrant.sa2: When the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN after a THROW, inflict STUN for 4 seconds. DRAIN 2/3/4% HEALTH per second from STUNNED opponents.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Temple Tyrant is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Due to her very fragile nature, players can build HP or Block Proficiency on her to increase her survivability.

Terror Byte.name: Terror Byte
Terror Byte.sa1: HEADRONE HITS (includes blocked hits) inflict INVERSE POLARITY and DISABLE opponent SPECIAL MOVES for 10/12/15 seconds each.
Terror Byte.sa2: While near an opponent suffering from a DEBUFF, both fighters gain 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Terror Byte is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her debuffs aren't resisted.

That's All Folks!.name: That's All Folks!
That's All Folks!.sa1: 15% chance when HIT to inflict ARMOR BREAK for 10 seconds and grant 3/4/5 stacks of PRECISION and 1 stack of EVASION.
That's All Folks!.sa2: While Peacock is alive, opponents have 50/60/75% reduced CRIT RATE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Peacock, That's All Folks! is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Thrill Shrieker.name: Thrill Shrieker
Thrill Shrieker.sa1: 50/75/100% chance to gain ENRAGE when gaining a DRAGON CHARGE. Each ENRAGE is removed when a charge is spent.
Thrill Shrieker.sa2: The opponent suffers damage equal to 25/35/50% of their current HEALTH when tagging out while Squigly has ENRAGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Thrill Shrieker is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Building Crit Rate and Crit Damage will further increase her damage potential.

Tidal Traveler.name: Tidal Traveler
Tidal Traveler.sa1: Puddle HITS grant IMMUNITY for 10/12/15 seconds.
Tidal Traveler.sa2: While benefitting from IMMUNITY, BUBBLE attacks deal 25/35/50% bonus damage. Also DISABLE BLOCKBUSTERS and inflict ARMOR BREAK for 15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Tidal Traveler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by enemies.

Time Thief.name: Time Thief
Time Thief.sa1: When landing a HIT while throwing her head, Ms. Fortune gains HASTE for 10 seconds and deals damage equal to 50/75/100% of her ATTACK.
Time Thief.sa2: 50/75/100% of the damage suffered while in HEADLESS MODE is regained when Ms. Fortune recalls her head.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Time Thief is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her access to HASTE.

Timeless Hero.name: Timeless Hero
Timeless Hero.sa1: Gain ENRAGE, AUTO-BLOCK or REGEN every 30/25/20 COMBO HITS. These BUFFs are removed when suffering a HIT.
Timeless Hero.sa2: Once per match when obtaining all of the above BUFFS, gain 50/75/100% BLOCKBUSTER METER and infinite STAR POWER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Timeless Hero is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often.

Toad Warrior.name: Toad Warrior
Toad Warrior.sa1: Gain 1/2/3% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while near an opponent.
Toad Warrior.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage while a BLOCKBUSTER is fully charged.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Toad Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely ignored, as Toad Warrior's Signature Ability already grants enough Blockbuster Meter.

Tomb & Gloom.name: Tomb & Gloom
Tomb & Gloom.sa1: Inflict WITHER, CURSE, QUIETUS or HEX for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER or SPECIAL MOVE.
Tomb & Gloom.sa2: Also gain 1 stack of EVASION for 5/7/10 seconds when using a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Eliza, Tomb & Gloom is best built with Attack, Accuracy, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow Tomb & Gloom to use her Signature Ability more often.

Treble Maker.name: Treble Maker
Treble Maker.sa1: Heal for 5/7/10% of your MAX HEALTH after every 10th COMBO HIT suffered.
Treble Maker.sa2: When HIT while above 50% HEALTH, reflect 15/25/35% of the incoming damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Big Band, Treble Maker is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. Do keep in mind that due to his Marquee Ability FRONTMAN, Big Band does not need more than 20% Resistance.
Special investment: Crit Resist is also recommended to stop players from using fighters like Cosmic Rebel and Triple Threat.

Trigger Happy.name: Trigger Happy
Trigger Happy.sa1: 50/75/100% of the damage dealt by STANDARD SHOTS is also suffered by the opponent's teammates.
Trigger Happy.sa2: Gain ENRAGE for 10/12/15 seconds each time the opponent's teammates take damage.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Trigger Happy is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.

Triple Threat.name: Triple Threat
Triple Threat.sa1: Gain IMMUNITY, UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE for 9/12/15 seconds when activating STAR POWER. The BUFF is removed when exiting STAR POWER.
Triple Threat.sa2: 33% chance when using a SPECIAL MOVE to reset all BUFF timers and gain 20/25/30% STAR POWER meter.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Tripe Threat is best built with Attack%, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will increase her BUFFS refreshing. While investing in Crit Damage will further increase her damage.

True Self.name: True Self
True Self.sa1: Fukua's successful KICK attacks grant a stack of SHADOW KICK (max. 10). Regain 1/1.5/2% MAX HEALTH when gaining a SHADOW KICK stack. The next BLOCKBUSTER used after reaching 10 SHADOW KICK stacks will summon GRENDEL'S HAND to HIT the opponent.
True Self.sa2: When GRENDEL's HAND successfully HITS, gain UNFLINCHING for 10/12/15 seconds. When gaining a SHADOW KICK stack while benefiting from UNFLINCHING, deal 2/2.5/3% MAX HEALTH as damage to the opponent and gain 2/3/4% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

Très Chic.name: Très Chic
Très Chic.sa1: While on her own side of the stage, Valentine gains 1 stack of BARRIER, THORNS or ARMOR every 5/4/3 seconds. These BUFFS are removed when KNOCKED DOWN.
Très Chic.sa2: While on the opponent's side of the stage, CRITICAL HITS inflict BLEED, DEATH MARK, or ARMOR BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Trés Chic is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Twisted Mettle.name: Twisted Mettle
Twisted Mettle.sa1: When suffering a CRITICAL HIT, inflict BLEED for 10/12/15 seconds.
Twisted Mettle.sa2: 25/35/50% chance on HIT to inflict BLEED for 3 seconds if opponent is suffering BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As a defensive Painwheel, Twisted Mettle is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chance of her inflicting BLEED.

Tyrannical.name: Tyrannical
Tyrannical.sa1: CRITICAL HITS have a 35% chance to inflict BLEED or grant MIASMA for 6 seconds each.
Tyrannical.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of MIASMA, or the opponent suffers from at least 3 stacks of BLEED, CRITICAL HITS have a 50% chance to remove 1 opponent BUFF.

Ultraviolent.name: Ultraviolent
Ultraviolent.sa1: Projectile HITS have a 25/35/50% chance to grant DEADEYE and BARRIER for 15 seconds each.
Ultraviolent.sa2: Projectiles HITS inflict 25/35/50% bonus damage and grant HASTE for 10 seconds while benefiting from DEADEYE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Ultraviolent is best built with Attack, Piercing, and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain should be completely avoided due to her access to HASTE. Crit Damage and Crit Rate can be used to increase her damage.

Unbearable.name: Unbearable
Unbearable.sa1: While Big Band has living teammates, the active Fighter gains a 35% chance when suffering a DEBUFF to convert it to BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds and heal all teammates for 5% MAX HEALTH.
Unbearable.sa2: With one teammate alive, Big Band takes 20% reduced damage and gains a 1% chance to instantly defeat the opponent with TIER 3 BLOCKBUSTER HITS. With no teammates alive, these effects are doubled.

Underdog.name: Underdog
Underdog.sa1: Gain ARMOR and HASTE for 10/12/15 seconds when suffering a DEBUFF.
Underdog.sa2: When Beowulf gains a BUFF, he also gains 5/7/10% BLOCKBUSTER METER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Underdog is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: As he naturally gains HASTE, try to avoid investing in Meter Gain, as Meter Gain caps at 100%.

Understudy.name: Understudy
Understudy.sa1: All teammates deal 15/30/50% increased throw damage.
Understudy.sa2: Gain ARMOR for 10/12/15 seconds when THROWING the opponent.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Cerebella, Understudy is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will allow Understudy to consistently inflict ARMOR BREAK. Meter Gain will also allow her to use like DIAMOND DROP more often.

Unfazed.name: Unfazed
Unfazed.sa1: Gain UNFLINCHING and 1/2/3 stack(s) of THORNS for 10 seconds each when either Fighter BOUNCES off a wall.
Unfazed.sa2: Gain MIASMA for 10 seconds every 4/3/2 seconds while benefiting from THORNS.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Dahlia, Unfazed is best built with Attack and Special Cooldown. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored.

Special investment: Players are advised not to invest in Crit Rate and Crit Damage, as Unfazed signature ability is perfect to counter Painwheels's TAINTED BLOOD Marquee Ability. With these, players can also avoid unlocking the Crit Rate and Crit Damage nodes in her skill tree. Due to her access to MIASMA, Meter Gain will also redundant, but players can choose to invest in this stat if they choose to. While only useful on defense on certain conditions, also investing in HP and Defense will make mistakes less punishing when on offense.

Unholy Host.name: Unholy Host
Unholy Host.sa1: When Black Dahlia or her opponent TAGS IN, she removes all enemy BUFFS and inflicts CURSE for 10/15/20 seconds.
Unholy Host.sa2: DRAIN 1/1.5/2% HEALTH per second from the opponent if they are suffering from CURSE.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used in offense, Unholy Host is best built with Attack, Special Cooldown, Crit Damage and Crit Rate. Due to Dahlias Prestige Ability that grants DEADEYE and Marquee Ability which inflicts ARMOR BREAK, Piercing can be completely ignored. If used defensively, Unholy Host is best built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance. If built Critless or does not have Prestige Ability unlocked, Unholy host will need investments in Piercing as she does not have access to reliable ARMOR BREAK and DEADEYE.
If built Critless or does not have Prestige Ability unlocked, Unholy host will need investments in Piercing as she does not have access to reliable ARMOR BREAK and DEADEYE.
Special investment: Investing in Accuracy will ensure that her CURSE is not resisted by enemies. Crit Damage and Crit Rate are also optional, as she can also be built critless.

Untouchable.name: Untouchable
Untouchable.sa1: 15% chance when either Fighter is hit to gain UNFLINCHING for 4/5/6 seconds and INVINCIBLE for 2 seconds.
Untouchable.sa2: While benefiting from UNFLINCHING or INVINCIBLE, deal 25/35/50% bonus damage and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used on defense, Untouchable is best built with HP, Defense, Meter Gain and Resistance. If used on offense, Untouchable is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her Signature Ability activating.

Vaporwave Vixen.name: Vaporwave Vixen
Vaporwave Vixen.sa1: After IDLING or WALKING for 3/2/1 seconds(s) without suffering a hit, gain UNFLINCHING.
Vaporwave Vixen.sa2: After Fukua and her opponent have not suffered a HIT (including blocked hits) for 2 seconds, gain THORNS and MIASMA for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: If used on offense, Vaporwave Vixen is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown. On defense, she should be built with HP, Meter Gain, Defense and Resistance.
Special investment: When used on offense, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will allow her to deal more outside of MIASMA.

Vector Protector.name: Vector Protector
Vector Protector.sa1: Gain ARMOR for 8/10/12 seconds and refresh the timer of all ARMORS when either Fighter uses a SPECIAL MOVE.
Vector Protector.sa2: Using a BLOCKBUSTER converts all ARMOR stacks into MIASMA for 8/10/12 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, Vector Protector is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Meter Gain will allow her to use blockbusters more often and gain more MIASMA.

Vintage Virtuoso.name: Vintage Virtuoso
Vintage Virtuoso.sa1: Gain 1 stack of PRECISION every 15/10/5 combo hits.
Vintage Virtuoso.sa2: PRECISION HITS grant ENRAGE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 5/7/10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Big Band, Vintage Virtuoso is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is recommended for Vintage Virtuoso to further increase his damage output. Accuracy will also ensure that defenders do not resist GUARD BREAK.

Wave Warrior.name: Wave Warrior
Wave Warrior.sa1: Every 15th COMBO HIT, transfer up to 2 opponent BUFFS to self and reduce opponent BLOCKBUSTER METER by 15/20/25%.
Wave Warrior.sa2: While Annie has living teammates, gaining a BUFF permanently increases DAMAGE by 5/7/10% and heals all teammates for 5% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Annie, Wave Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing, Crit Rate and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Investing in Meter Gain will allow her to use Blockbusters more often and reach high combos to activate her Signature Ability.
preferred_moveset: Umbrella Raining Champ Portrait / Valentine Surgeon General Portrait / Annie Starlight Rose Portrait

Web Crawler.name: Web Crawler
Web Crawler.sa1: After Painwheel has been in the air for 1 second, gain DEADEYE and inflict GUARD BREAK for 10/11/12 seconds each.
Web Crawler.sa2: 10/12/15% chance on HIT to remove 1 opponent BUFF and gain EVASION for 10 seconds while near an opponent suffering from GUARD BREAK.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Painwheel, Web Crawler is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage output further. Accuracy will ensure that her GUARD BREAK isn't resisted by defenders.

Weekend Warrior.name: Weekend Warrior
Weekend Warrior.sa1: Achieve max HYPE and gain HASTE for 10 seconds when Beowulf first drops below 25/35/50% HEALTH.
Weekend Warrior.sa2: When activating HYPE MODE, remove all DEBUFFS and gain IMMUNITY, FINAL STAND, and HEAVY REGEN for 10/12/15 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Weekend Warrior is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special investment: As Weekend Warrior is most often played with a taunt that gives HASTE, Meter Gain is not a recommended stat to build on him, as well as avoiding Crit Rate and Crit Damage. Instead, players are advised to build HP, which increases his survivability on the field and reduces chip damage suffered.

Wetwork.name: Wetwork
Wetwork.sa1: Gain EVASION every 2/1.5/1 second(s) while charging a CHARGE ATTACK.
Wetwork.sa2: When knocking an opponent into the air, Valentine gains ENRAGE and the opponent suffers ARMOR BREAK and DEATH MARK for 4/5/7 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Valentine, Wetwork is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy, Crit Rate and Crit Damage will increase her damage by taking use of her Signature Ability fully.

Wild Child.name: Wild Child
Wild Child.sa1: While not OVERSTUFFED, Umbrella's THROW HITS have a 20% chance to DRAIN 10/12/15% of the opponent's BLOCKBUSTER METER.
Wild Child.sa2: Inflict 2 stacks of SLIME for 10/12/15 seconds when the opponent is KNOCKED DOWN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Wild Child is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will increase the chances of her draining Blockbuster Meter.

Wildcard.name: Wildcard
Wildcard.sa1: Inflict a random DEBUFF for 4/6/8 seconds when using a SPECIAL MOVE. Also once per match when suffering a HIT that would be fatal, regain 10% MAX HEALTH per DEBUFF on the opponent.
Wildcard.sa2: When Peacock suffers a HIT that would be fatal while the opponent is suffering a DEBUFF, reduce their HEALTH by 25/35/50%.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Peacock, Wild Card is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Accuracy will ensure that her DEBUFFS aren't resisted by her enemies.

Wind Stalker.name: Wind Stalker
Wind Stalker.sa1: DRAIN 3/4/5% BLOCKBUSTER METER per second while the opponent is near Ms. Fortune's head.
Wind Stalker.sa2: Inflict QUIETUS, DEATH MARK, DISABLE TAG INS, and DOOM for 15 seconds each when an opponent's HEALTH drops below 25/30/35%. DOOM is removed if the opponent uses a BLOCKBUSTER.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Ms. Fortune, Wind Stalker is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage and Crit Rate will further increase her damage output while in the field and take the most use out of the Ms. Fortune Kit.

Windswept.name: Windswept
Windswept.sa1: Your 1st COMBO HIT against an attacking opponent grants ENRAGE for 5/7/10 seconds and EVASION.
Windswept.sa2: After EVADING, 50/75/100% chance to gain PERMANENT PRECISION. PRECISION is removed when either Fighter is KNOCKED DOWN.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Filia, Windswept is best built with Attack, Piercing, Meter Gain and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage is the most important stat for Windswept, while Crit Rate should be completely ignored, as Windswept has access to easy permanent PRECISION.

Wrestler X.name: Wrestler X
Wrestler X.sa1: Beowulf starts the match with 1/2/3 stacks of permanent REGEN.
Wrestler X.sa2: While in HYPE MODE, all HITS have a 15/20/25% chance to inflict BLEED for 10 seconds.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Wrestler X is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.

Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will increase the chances of Wrestler X inflicting his BLEED. As he is most often played with a taunt that gives HASTE, Meter Gain is not a recommended stat to build on him.

Wulfsbane.name: Wulfsbane
Wulfsbane.sa1: THROWS have a 50% chance to inflict CRIPPLE and HEAL BLOCK for 5/7/10 seconds.
Wulfsbane.sa2: Deal 25/35/50% bonus damage against enemies suffering from a DEBUFF.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Beowulf, Wulfsbane is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown
Special Investment: Investment in Accuracy will increase the chances of him inflicting his DEBUFFS. Investing in Meter Gain is not ideal, as Beowulf has access to HASTE through his TAUNT.

Wunderkind.name: Wunderkind
Wunderkind.sa1: 50% chance on BLOCKBUSTER HIT to inflict POWER SURGE and gain BARRIER for 10/12/15 seconds each (also applies on blocked hits).
Wunderkind.sa2: While Umbrella is alive, the active fighter DRAINS 3/4/5% of the opponent's HEALTH every 3 seconds while they are suffering from 3 or more stacks of POWER SURGE.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Umbrella, Wunderkind is best built with Attack and Piercing.

Special investment: Meter Gain is an especially important stat as Wunderkind relies heavily on BLOCKBUSTER usage. Accuracy will increase the chances of the POWER SURGE landing as well as counter built Resistance stats on the opponent.

X-Bot.name: X-Bot
X-Bot.sa1: Gain PRECISION and inflict DEATH MARK after 3/2/1 second(s) while far away from the opponent.
X-Bot.sa2: Also gain BARRIER and heal for 3/4/5% HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Robo-Fortune, X-Bot is best built with Attack, Piercing and Special Cooldown.
Special investment: Crit Damage will drastically improve her damage output by taking use of her PRECISION.

Xenomorph.name: Xenomorph
Xenomorph.sa1: 50/75/100% chance when TRANSMUTING to the DARK element to inflict a permanent DOOM effect, killing the enemy after 30 seconds. DOOM will be removed if Double is defeated.
Xenomorph.sa2: When defeated, inflict 1/2/3 stack(s) of permanent BLEED.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Double, Xenomorph is best built with Attack, Crit Rate, Accuracy and Piercing.
Special investment: Accuracy is one of the most important stats, as it ensures that her DOOM and BLEED are not resisted.

Yellow One.name: Yellow One
Yellow One.sa1: Gain BLESSING every 5 seconds. This BLESSING always lasts for 1/1.5/2 second(s) and becomes permanent when using SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS. Permanent BLESSINGS are removed when this BLESSING expires.
Yellow One.sa2: While benefiting from at least 3 stacks of permanent BLESSING, SPECIAL MOVES and BLOCKBUSTERS are UNBLOCKABLE and regain 25/35/50% of damage inflicted as HEALTH.

stat_investment: General Investment: As an offensive Squigly, Yellow One is best built with Attack, Piercing, Special Cooldown and Meter Gain.
Special investment: No Special Investment is needed for this variant.
